jobs.description:
Job Description

RPM Partners () is seeking a Managing Director with deep automotive and manufacturing restructuring expertise to advise clients through complex, high-stakes situations by delivering hands-on operational and financial solutions that strengthen performance and enterprise value.

What it Means to Work for RPM Partners:

  • You will have access to the breadth of resources and capabilities of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry

  • You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance

  • You will join a culture that has received multiple top “Places to Work” awards

    • We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create new solutions

    • We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation

    • Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work

What Work You Will be Responsible For:

  • Lead complex restructuring, turnaround, and performance improvement engagements within the automotive and manufacturing sectors

  • Serve as the senior restructuring leader and trusted advisor in high-stakes situations involving lenders, sponsors, management teams, suppliers, customers, and other key stakeholders

  • Advise Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) and automotive suppliers on liquidity management, operational stabilization, restructuring strategies, and business transformation initiatives

  • Drive strategic and financial decision-making through sophisticated financial analysis, operational insight, and stakeholder negotiations

  • Analyze and interpret complex financial and legal documents, including loan agreements, forbearance agreements, accommodation agreements, access agreements, and related stakeholder documentation

  • Oversee supplier engagement and supply chain stabilization efforts during distressed and transitional situations

  • Perform Chief Restructuring Officer (CRO)-type responsibilities, including cash flow oversight, operational execution, stakeholder communications, and turnaround implementation

  • Lead and mentor engagement teams while managing multiple client engagements in fast-paced environments

  • Develop and maintain strong client relationships and drive business development opportunities across the restructuring and automotive markets

  • Deliver exceptional client service and thought leadership in complex advisory engagements

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in restructuring, turnaround, insolvency advisory, or performance improvement consulting

  • Proven first-chair experience leading complex restructuring and turnaround engagements

  • Significant experience advising automotive OEMs and suppliers

  • Deep understanding of stakeholder dynamics, leverage points, and multi-party negotiations

  • Strong experience with complex financial analysis, distressed situations, and operational improvement initiatives

  • Experience reviewing and negotiating complex financial and legal documents

  • Demonstrated success performing CRO-type advisory work

  • Proven business development and client relationship management capabilities

  • Strong interpersonal, organizational, leadership, and team management skills

Preferred/Desired Qualifications/Credentials:

  • MBA or other relevant advanced degree preferred

  • CPA, CIRA, CTP, CFA, or other relevant professional certification

EisnerAmper is proud to be a merit-based employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of veteran or disability status or any protected characteristics under federal, state, or local law.

About RPM Partners:

RPM Partners is a joint venture partner of Eisner Advisory Group, LLC, focused on global turnaround and restructuring services for financially and operationally distressed automotive supply chains.

About EisnerAmper:

EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax, and business advisory firms, with approximately 450 partners and 4,500 employees across the world. We combine responsiveness with a long-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today and position them for success tomorrow.

Our clients represent enterprises of every form, ranging from sophisticated financial institutions to startups, global public firms to middle-market companies, governmental entities as well as high-net-worth individuals, family offices, nonprofit organizations and entrepreneurial ventures across a variety of industries. We are also engaged by the attorneys, financial professionals, bankers, investors, and key stakeholders who serve these clients.

jobs.description:
Location:

Miramar, Florida

At Memorial, we are dedicated to improving the health, well-being and, most of all, quality of life for the people entrusted to our care. An unwavering commitment to our service vision is what makes the difference. It is the foundation of The Memorial Experience.

Summary:

Reviews medical record documentation. May assign codes to medical diagnoses, procedures and modifiers, when applicable, using appropriate coding classifications for assigned areas/record types to ensure proper billing and compliance.

Responsibilities:

Enhances and maintains coding knowledge and skills. Reviews all appropriate work queues daily to address edits and makes corrections following procedures and processes. Seeks clarification from healthcare providers or other designated resources to ensure accurate and complete coding.For physician billing, collaborates with billing department to ensure all bills are satisfied. For hospital, routes to billing charge entry errors and/or account edits preventing completion of coding and/or billing. Makes appropriate coding corrections, when advised, and follows procedure to notify billing.Reviews and validates the accuracy of data in the Admission, Discharge Transfer (ADT) fields following HIM coding procedures and processes.May assign and sequence basic CPT (Current Procedural Terminology) procedure codes (non-complex), and modifiers based on medical record documentation in accordance with Official Coding Guidelines, CMS regulations, Local Medical Review Policy (LMRP) guidance in encoder software and/or department coding policies and procedures. Using encoder, reviews Ambulatory Payment Classifications (APC) and Enhanced Ambulatory Patient Groups (EAPG) assignments. Reviews Local Coverage Determination (LCD) edits and guidance for codes meeting medical necessity. Researches medical record for any additional diagnoses documented to meet medical necessity.Conducts audits and/or coding reviews with various health care professionals to ensure all documentation is accurate (physician billing).Communicates with insurance companies about coding errors and disputes (physician billing). Abstracts pertinent data points for billing and quality reviews. Communicates with various departments as needed to ensure accuracy of patient data.Submits daily productivity report to HIM manager by defined deadline. Meets and maintains HIM coding quality and productivity standards. Attends internal and external educational meetings and seminars to maintain certification and continuing education requirements.Reviews medical record documentation to determine all appropriate diagnosis (including HCC Coding Hierarchical Condition Category), procedural and modifier code assignments. For hospital coding, reviews medical record documentation (i.e., provider orders); may code outpatient diagnostic and therapeutic encounters requiring minimal procedural coding.

Competencies:

ACCOUNTABILITY, ACCURACY (DRG), ACCURACY - CODER, ACCURACY - OUTPATIENT, ANALYSIS AND DECISION MAKING, CUSTOMER SERVICE, EFFECTIVE COMMUNICATION, HEALTH INFORMATION MANAGEMENT (HIM) SYSTEMS - CODER, HEALTH INFORMATION MNGMT, MEDICAL RECORD CODING, MEDICAL TERMINOLOGY (1), PRODUCTIVITY - IP CODING, RESPONDING TO CHANGE, STANDARDS OF BEHAVIOR, TEAM WORK

High School Diploma or Equivalent (Required)Certified Coding Associate (CCA) - American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA), Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) - American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA), Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA) - American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA), Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT) - State of Florida (FL), Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT AHIMA) - American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA)

Complexity of Work: Requires critical thinking skills, effective communication skills, decisive judgment, and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Must be able to work in a stressful environment and take appropriate action. Proficient in basic computer skills. Ability to perform job duties using an electronic medical record system. Strong knowledge of anatomy, physiology and medical terminology. Knowledge of coding classification systems and procedures.Required Work Experience: For HIM coder, one (1) year hospital-based outpatient coding experience. For Physician Billing Coder, one (1) year diagnostic/procedural office coding experience with surgical coding experience or six (6) months working within the Memorial Health System.Other Information: For HIM: Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT), or Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA), or Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) or Certified Coding Associate (CCA).For Physician Billing: Certified Professional Coder (CPC), Certified Professional Medical Auditor (CPMA), Certified Risk Adjustment Coder (CRC) by AAPC, or Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Certified Coding Specialist - Physician Based (CCSP) by AHIMA.For Hospital Billing: Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), Certified Coding Associate (CCA) or Certified Professional Coder (CPC).

jobs.title: Manager, Client Support Operations
jobs.excerpt: Job Description: The Manager, Client Support Operations leads a team responsible for delivering high-quality technical and application support to clients across assigned products or solution areas.
jobs.description:
Job Description:

The Manager, Client Support Operations leads a team responsible for delivering high-quality technical and application support to clients across assigned products or solution areas. This role is accountable for team performance, operational execution, escalation management, and client support outcomes. The Manager provides day-to-day leadership to ensure support processes are executed consistently, service commitments are met, and client issues are resolved effectively. This role partners cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Platform, Client Success, and other internal teams to resolve complex client issues, improve operational processes, and enhance the overall client support experience. The position is responsible for developing team capability, maintaining operational discipline, monitoring service performance, and driving continuous improvement across support operations. This role may support one or more product or solution areas such as Clinicals, Technical Performance, Patient Experience, Interoperability, Financials, or other enterprise solutions.
  • Lead, coach, and develop Client Support Operations team members, including performance management, goal setting, and professional development.
  • Participate in hiring, onboarding, and workforce planning to maintain appropriate staffing levels and team capability.
  • Manage day-to-day support operations for assigned products or solution areas, ensuring consistent execution of support processes and service standards.
  • Own operational performance of the Client Support Operations team, ensuring service levels, response times, and resolution standards are consistently achieved.
  • Utilize AI-driven analytics to identify systemic risks, performance trends, and adoption gaps that inform enterprise strategy.
  • Monitor team performance using operational and service metrics and take corrective action when performance targets are not met.
  • Oversee complex, high-impact client issues and escalations, providing clear direction, communication, and ownership through resolution.
  • Support client satisfaction and service quality objectives by ensuring timely issue resolution, effective communication, and positive client support experiences.
  • Ensure adherence to service level commitments, escalation protocols, documentation standards, and knowledge management practices.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Platform, Client Success, Training, and other internal stakeholders to resolve client issues and improve support outcomes.
  • Drive root cause analysis and corrective action planning to reduce repeat issues, improve processes, and strengthen the client experience.
  • Use data and performance trends to identify operational risks, service gaps, staffing needs, and improvement opportunities.
  • Promote a culture of operational discipline, continuous improvement, collaboration, and client focus.
  • Contribute to operational readiness and support planning for new products, releases, enhancements, or business initiatives.
  • Prepare and communicate operational updates, issue trends, and team performance insights to leadership.
  • Perform other duties that support the overall objective of the position.

Education Required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, Healthcare Administration, or a related field.
  • Or, any combination of education and experience which would provide the required qualifications for the position.

Experience Required:

  • 6+ years of experience in technical support, application support, client services, or related operational support roles.
  • 2+ years of people leadership experience with responsibility for coaching, performance management, and team development.
  • Experience managing escalated client issues in a client-facing support environment.
  • Experience using operational metrics and service data to monitor team performance and drive improvements.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with product, engineering, or service teams to resolve complex client issues.
  • Experience supporting enterprise software, SaaS platforms, or healthcare technology solutions preferred.

License/Certification Required:

  • ITIL or other service management certification preferred.
  • Leadership, operations, or project management certifications preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Knowledge of: Client support operations and service delivery practices. Technical and application support models in enterprise software or healthcare technology environments. Escalation management processes and issue resolution practices. Workforce planning and resource management within a support organization. Operational performance metrics and service level commitments. Root cause analysis and continuous improvement methods. Knowledge management and support documentation standards. Cross-functional collaboration across Product, Engineering, Platform, and Client Success teams. Client relationship management principles and customer service practices. Assigned product, solution, workflow, or vertical-specific business processes sufficient to support clients effectively.
  • Skill in: Leading and developing teams in a client-facing support environment. Managing complex client escalations with sound judgment and clear communication. Interpreting operational data, performance metrics, and service trends. Identifying process improvement opportunities and driving operational change. Building effective cross-functional partnerships. Communicating effectively with employees, leadership, and clients. Organizing work, setting priorities, and managing competing demands. Driving accountability while maintaining a strong service orientation. Problem solving, decision making, and operational planning.
  • Ability to: Lead a support team with a high degree of accountability and client focus. Balance team leadership, client needs, and operational priorities. Resolve complex issues and escalations with professionalism and ownership. Analyze operational data and translate findings into actionable improvements. Improve team performance through coaching, feedback, and clear expectations. Build credibility and strong working relationships across teams and leadership levels. Adapt to changing business priorities, product needs, and client demands. Maintain operational discipline, documentation quality, and process adherence. Support multiple products, verticals, or solution areas using a consistent support model. Work in a fast-paced environment while managing competing priorities and deadlines.

jobs.title: Credit Card Business Risk Control Manager - Remote
jobs.excerpt: Company Overview:At Snap Finance, we believe everyone deserves access to the things they need, regardless of credit history.
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

At Snap Finance, we believe everyone deserves access to the things they need, regardless of credit history. Since 2012, we've used data, machine learning, and a more human approach to create flexible financing solutions that help people move forward. We're proud of our inclusive, supportive culture, built on empowering our customers, partners, and team members alike. When our people thrive, so does our innovation.

If you're looking to make an impact and grow with a team that values you, come join us!

Job Description

The Internal Credit Card Risk Manager is responsible for overseeing the identification, assessment, mitigation, and monitoring of compliance and operational risks across the credit card organization. This role partners closely with business leaders, Internal Audit, Risk Management, and Compliance stakeholders to drive effective issue remediation, risk assessment activities, control development, and governance processes. The position serves as the primary owner of the GRC platform for the credit card business and ensures regulatory requirements, risks, controls, and remediation activities are accurately documented, maintained, and monitored.

How you'll make an impact:

Operational Issue Management

  • Partner with business stakeholders across card to review, assess, and remediate operational issues resulting from control failures, process breakdowns, audit findings, or risk events.
  • Facilitate root cause analysis and develop remediation plans to ensure identified risks and control deficiencies are effectively addressed.
  • Monitor issue remediation activities and ensure corrective actions are completed within established timelines.
  • Provide reporting and status updates to management and governance committees regarding issue remediation progress and emerging risks.
  • Promote consistent issue management practices and adherence to risk management standards across the organization.

Audit Issue Management

  • Partner with issue owners and business stakeholders across card to develop and execute remediation plans for audit findings and regulatory observations.
  • Coordinate the preparation and submission of documentation and evidence required to support remediation efforts and audit requests.
  • Track audit findings through closure and ensure remediation activities satisfy audit and regulatory expectations.
  • Serve as a liaison between Internal Audit, Compliance, Risk Management, and business teams to facilitate timely issue resolution.
  • Maintain comprehensive records of audit findings, remediation activities, and supporting documentation.

GRC Governance and Ownership

  • Serve as the business owner and primary administrator for AuditBoard.
  • Establish and manage user access controls, permissions, and governance processes within the platform.
  • Develop and deliver training to ensure effective utilization of AuditBoard by business stakeholders.
  • Partner with AuditBoard administrators and vendors to represent business requirements and advocate for enhancements and platform improvements.
  • Ensure AuditBoard data integrity, reporting accuracy, and alignment with organizational risk and compliance management objectives.
  • Support ongoing optimization of AuditBoard workflows, reporting capabilities, and user experience.

Risk Assessments and Risk Management

  • Develop and maintain the annual Risk and Control Self-Assessment (RCSA) schedule.
  • Lead risk assessments associated with new products, services, business initiatives, and operational processes.
  • Facilitate RCSA workshops and provide effective challenge to business partners to ensure risks are appropriately identified, assessed, and documented.
  • Maintain and update the organization's risk inventory, ensuring risks remain accurately categorized and assessed.
  • Conduct annual and ongoing risk assessments to evaluate changes in risk exposure and control effectiveness.
  • Analyze risk assessment results and recommend mitigation strategies to address identified gaps and emerging risks.
  • Prepare risk reporting and presentations for management and governance forums.

Control Development and Governance

  • Ensure regulatory requirements, operational risks, and associated controls are accurately documented and maintained within AuditBoard.
  • Maintain oversight of risk-to-control mapping and ensure relationships between risks, controls, policies, and procedures remain current and complete.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance control documentation, including control descriptions, procedures, process flows, and evidence requirements.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to design and implement controls that effectively mitigate compliance and operational risks.
  • Ensure procedures and controls are documented, reviewed, and approved prior to implementation.
  • Coordinate control testing and validation activities to confirm controls are operating effectively before deployment and on an ongoing basis.
  • Support control monitoring, issue identification, and continuous improvement initiatives.

What you'll need to succeed:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, Risk Management, Compliance, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in credit card Compliance, Operational Risk Management, Internal Audit, Risk and Controls, or related financial services functions.
  • Strong knowledge of risk management frameworks, RCSA methodologies, issue management practices, and control design principles.
  • Experience managing audit findings, regulatory examinations, and remediation programs.
  • Hands-on experience with (GRC) platforms.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and project management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex risk and compliance topics to diverse audiences.
  • Knowledge of financial services regulatory requirements and compliance frameworks preferred.

Why Join Us:

  • Generous paid time off

  • Competitive medical, dental & vision coverage

  • 401K with company match for US

  • Company-paid life insurance

  • Company-paid short-term and long-term disability

  • Access to mental health and wellness resources

  • Company-paid volunteer time to do good in your community

  • Legal coverage and other supplemental options

  • A value-based culture where growth opportunities are endless

jobs.description:
Management Level

F

EQ Customer Resolutions has 25 years’ experience of providing contingent resource and technology solutions to regulated industries, including banks, lending, pension, insurance, and the utility providers. We have supported our clients with every major complaint populations, covering pensions review, endowments, banking, Payment Protection Insurance (PPI), and car finance. Our projects range from one or two complaint handlers for a few weeks, through to hundreds of experts needed for major complaint management projects.

In addition to complaint expertise, we have also supported many organisations with complaint handling solutions, technology, remediation requirements, consulting, and data analytics.


SUMMARY OF THE ROLE

The Client Services Manager plays a pivotal role in supporting the clients of Equiniti Customer Resolutions’ (EQCR) workflow management technology. The core focus of the Client Services Manager is acting as the primary liaison between the clients using the platform and the business; providing day to day relationship management, supporting finance and legal processes (such as contracting, renewals and vendor management activity) and helping clients get the most from the platform.

EQCR provide technology solutions to support case management and workflow primarily in the customer resolutions space (complaints and remediation) but have been deployed for other use cases. The role of the Client Services Manager ensures clients are well supported and have a positive experience over the life of the deployment. Typically clients remain on an EQCR solution for many years, with some relationships in excess of 20 years. The role holder will help to identify where EQCR can provide enhancements to the existing solution as well as offering complimentary services from the wider EQCR capabilities, such as resourcing, data services and consulting that support the clients business.

This dynamic role requires someone who can think on their feet, isn’t afraid of a challenge and can communicate well across all areas of a business, including dealing with senior stakeholders.

The Client Services Manager will bring experience in managing clients, have an understanding of technology/software provision and a strong capability in dealing with a wide range of client requests in an often fast-paced environment.

  • Engage with client stakeholders and internal EQ stakeholders to ensure the solution is best configured to meet the customer’s continued business needs.
  • Supporting the wider EQCR Consulting and Implementations management team with the overall delivery portfolio.
  • Maintain the EQCR Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery approaches including the support of annual testing.
  • Identify and take the lead on internal improvement projects.

PERSON SPECIFICATION

Education, Skills & Knowledge

  • Educated to degree level or equivalent, or demonstrate equivalent work experience.
  • Good knowledge of software delivery and support processes.
  • Comfortable hosting and facilitating meetings with diverse groups of stakeholders, both remotely and in person.
  • Excellent organisational skills with an ability to handle multiple complex and concurrent requirements within agreed timescales.
  • Good skills in MS Office.

Experience

jobs.title: Product Engineer, Tech Ops
jobs.excerpt: 👋 About Advocate Advocate () is transforming how Americans access government benefits.
jobs.description:
👋 About Advocate
Advocate () is transforming how Americans access government benefits. Our mission is to drive the time between need and relief down to zero. We have demonstrated significant progress toward this goal by combining proprietary AI-powered technology with expert human care and compassion. This approach provides an unparalleled experience for our claimants and, crucially, supports our government partners by reducing administrative burdens and enabling more efficient eligibility determinations.
We’ve proven our cutting-edge AI technology works. Now, we are focused on scaling the distribution of our offering and the operations that support it. This is a unique challenge that requires a combination of high-tech precision and human-centered support.
Tech Ops at Advocate
At Advocate, the Tech Ops team is the connective tissue of the organization. We sit at the intersection of technology, marketing, and operations, ensuring these functions remain perfectly synchronized as we scale. We are not an IT support desk; we are front-line builders. We operate in the trenches alongside our internal users who work directly with our claimants. Our mandate is twofold:
1. Short-Term Agility: We keep the lights on and the systems humming. When roadblocks appear in production, we are there to patch them and ensure our team can continue serving claimants without friction.
2. Long-Term Scalability: We don't just fix problems; we observe patterns. We recognize recurring operational challenges and build scalable technology solutions that eliminate those hurdles for good.
Tech Ops serves at the pleasure of those serving our claimants, empowering them to do their very best work every single day while contributing to our overall mission to drive time-to-relief down to zero.
💪 The Opportunity
We are hiring for two Product Engineers to join our Tech Ops team. If you join us, these are some of the projects you will likely own:
The End-to-End Journey Workbench. This is one of our most ambitious initiatives. We are building a centralized internal workbench to visualize the entire claimant journey, from the first ad click to the final case closure. You will build the connectivity and insights to track every onboarding step, Social Security submission, case data update, medical event, and communication touchpoint. This platform will allow us to see exactly where pipelines fail, where they succeed, and what the actual human experience feels like across the entire lifecycle.
Building the External Claimant Portal. Today, claimants get updates by talking directly to our case managers. Internal and external user sentiment is overwhelming: we need a portal where users can pull real-time case status, push medical evidence directly from their providers, and receive critical updates. You could own this build from architectural design to user adoption.
Engineering the Growth Engine. We are scaling our marketing operations. This involves building data warehouse pipelines to trigger outbound communications via platforms like Iterable, integrating with PPC platforms (Google, Meta, Microsoft) for conversion tracking, and ensuring our attribution models are bulletproof. You will be the primary bridge between engineering and our growth team.
AI-Driven Developer Velocity. We want to turn "I see something" into "We did something" faster than ever. We are building a pipeline that takes change requests from Slack and uses LLMs with full repository context to automatically open a Pull Request for engineer review. We aim to automate the distance between operational feedback and production fixes.
Front-Line Firefighting & System Resilience. TechOps is a high-availability environment. While we build for the future, we also protect the present. You will field ad hoc requests and production fires, ensuring our claimants never lose access to relief. You will be expected to master the balance between short-term viability and long-term stability: fixing the immediate issue while refactoring the system so it stays fixed for good.
Next-Gen Platform Migration. As our Platform Engineering team builds the infrastructure to support new government benefits, such as Veterans’ affairs, you will lead the migration and integration of our current tech stack onto this new architecture, ensuring zero downtime for our active operations.
Operational Digitization & Automation. We still deal with the physical world. You will work on projects to digitize and automate physical mail processing, automate complex government forms, and establish deep observability across all our systems to create a single source of truth for our data.
👨‍🚒 The Requirements
We operate as a high-leverage, specialized unit at Advocate. We are a small team of A-players who value excellence, high availability, and bias for action. We don’t just maintain systems; we are the force multipliers for the entire organization.
Extreme Ownership. We need proactive drivers who own projects from gut feeling to production success. You don’t ask "Are we there yet?" You build the map and drive the car. You take responsibility for the ongoing success of your work, including opex, user adoption, and long-term stability.
User-Obsessed Iteration. Great product engineers don't just read tickets; they build relationships with their users. You’ll talk to our users frequently, bounce ideas off them, and humble yourself to build what they actually need. You treat user feedback and system data as your primary north star.
Observability over Guesswork. You believe that if it isn't measured, it isn't finished. You bake deep observability into every system you build so that data, not just opinions, drives our roadmap. By making system health and user behavior visible, you ease the burden of decision-making and allow the team to move faster with higher confidence.
Massive Imperfect Action. You have a heavy bias toward shipping. You understand that the perfect tenth iteration is only possible after shipping versions one through nine. You’d rather ship a helpful MVP today and iterate tomorrow than spend a month in a back room building a masterpiece that no one asked for.
Optimistic Problem Solvers. TechOps is challenging. Between scaling systems, shipping complex features, and handling a stream of support requests, things get hard. We need people who won't get disheartened, people who will collaborate, iterate, and ship their way out of any corner.
The "Camera On" Mindset. This isn't a role for the lone wolf developer. You are part of a high-availability, highly collaborative team. You are comfortable being disrupted, you stay available to your peers, and you thrive in an environment where communication is constant and transparent.
Technical Excellence in the Age of AI. While AI helps us move faster, you provide the foundational CS principles and architectural oversight that tools can't. You focus on scalability, maintainability, and deep observability. You ensure the systems we build are well-architected, stable, and easy to support when they break.
The Support-Build Balance. You have the patience and professional maturity to balance new system build-outs with the reality of ongoing support. You take pride in maintaining a healthy codebase and refactoring systems to ensure they remain reliable as we grow.
Trust and Feedback over Process. We value autonomy over control. You are expected to give and receive direct, constructive feedback and be generous with praise when it’s earned. You don't wait for sign-offs or permission; you push forward based on intuition and data.
👨‍💻 Tech Stack
  • Full-stack (TypeScript): TypeScript, React, Next.js, Nx, Node.js, GraphQL — building and maintaining full-stack apps in a monorepo.
  • Data: PostgreSQL, TypeORM, Redis — schema design, migrations, caching, and query performance.
  • Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform, Docker — running and evolving cloud infra and containerized services.
  • Integrations: Salesforce, Zendesk — CRM and support tooling, APIs, and sync patterns.
  • Marketing: Customer.io or Iterable, Webflow, paid ads (Google, Meta, Microsoft), conversion tracking — lifecycle messaging, marketing sites, paid campaigns, and attribution.
  • AI: LLM integration in production — prompting, tool use, RAG/agents, evaluation and safety, and when to use AI vs other approaches.
  • Quality & observability: Sentry, PostHog, Playwright — errors, product analytics, and reliable browser automation and E2E tests.
  • Data/analytics: Python, Databricks — pipelines, notebooks, and analytics workflows.
💰 Benefits
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Access a full suite of medical, dental, and vision plans for you and your family, including $0 premium options and FSA/HSA accounts to suit your needs.
  • Time to Recharge: Balance work and life with 15 days of accrued PTO, 11 paid federal holidays, and dedicated sick leave for recovery and medical appointments.
  • Family-First Support: We provide 8 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents, plus an additional 2-week flex time transition period to help you ease back into work.
  • Professional Growth: Invest in your career with a $500 annual learning stipend plus 2 dedicated Growth Days each year to focus exclusively on your professional development.
  • Flexible Remote Culture: Work from wherever you are most productive. We use Slack and Gather to stay connected across time zones and host in-person team offsites up to six times per year.
  • Compensation & Ownership: We offer market-competitive salaries with performance-based raises and equity grants, ensuring every employee shares in Advocate’s long-term success.
⚙️ Interview Process
1. Application. Our Tech Ops team will review your application. We’re looking to see how your skills and experience align with our needs.
2. Culture Interview. 45-minute video call with Kyle, Head of Tech Ops. Our goal is to explore your motivations to join our team, learn why you'd be a great fit, and answer questions about us.
3. Technical Interview. 75-minute video call with Kyle and Min, Tech Ops Product Engineer. You’ll choose from a list of current problem statements at the company – things you could very well be working on – and lead us through user interviews, requirements gathering, solutioning tradeoffs, and architecture diagramming. We want to see how you think and experience what it’s like to work with you on hard problems.
4. Company Interview. 30-minute video call with our CTO, Charley.
5. Offer. We’re a match! We’ll make you an offer to join the Advocate team!

For more than 30 years, TCP has helped organizations engage their people by providing flexible, mobile timekeeping and workforce management solutions. The Enterprise Growth AE owns a book of large, complex TCP accounts and is responsible for growing revenue within them. This is not an account management role. You will identify expansion opportunities across new products, departments, and locations, and run a full enterprise sales cycle to close them. Your buyer is often an executive you have not yet met.   • Partner with Customer Success on account context and renewal timing while owning the expansion sales motion independently.
  • Travel up to 25%.

  • 4-5+ years of quota-carrying B2B sales experience with full-cycle ownership (prospecting to close).

Deal Management

Title: Account Executive – MSWarehouse
Reports to: Vice President, Business Development

Your primary focus will be on new sales for our warehouse management solution, an economical and easy to use tool to help companies manage their small to medium-sized warehouses. Working primarily with new territories, you will use your business development skills and industry knowledge to identify new prospects and create sales opportunities. With the assistance of our Technical Sales Specialist, you will then manage the sales cycle with each prospect through the proposal and contracting up to and including closing the business. Your daily focus will be on lead generation, with less than 25% of your time on proposals and contracting.   • Evaluate potential customers to determine how our products can best serve them and to identify the most effective sales approach for each prospect.
  • Develop proposals and conduct client sales presentations with the support of our Technical Sales Specialist
  • Negotiate and close new business agreements
  • Utilize Salesforce to manage leads, opportunities, contracts, and activities.
  • Work with EWS / Cora team on marketing initiatives to generate leads.
  • Attend industry conferences, meetings, and events to expand knowledge and build your prospect funnel.
  • Monitor your sales goals, ensuring alignment with company objectives.
  • Manage expectations, set realistic goals, and deliver results for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Prioritize and manage time effectively to maximize productivity.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience in the Warehousing industry with a solid understanding of financial metrics and business drivers
  • Proven track record of success in high volume business development activities, with a track record of cold outreach and sales conversion and a history of meeting and exceeding targets.
  • Strong record of success in sales, business development, and new business acquisition.
  • Demonstrated ability to increase revenue through effective lead generation.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment with competing priorities.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills—able to build genuine connections from skilled labor to C-suite executives.
  • Clear and confident verbal and written communication.

  • Establish and drive best practices, playbooks, and operational processes across the Customer Success organization
  • Monitor team KPIs including retention, churn, expansion, customer health, onboarding success, and customer satisfaction metrics

  • Partner with leadership to define regional customer success strategy and execution priorities
  • Ensure consistent customer engagement standards and service quality across all managed accounts
  • Support hiring, onboarding, training, and performance management of Customer Success team members
  • Foster strong cross-functional collaboration between Customer Success, Sales, Product, Support, and Operations teams

  • Drive a customer-centric culture focused on accountability, operational excellence, and measurable business outcomes

  • 2+ years of experience leading or mentoring customer-facing teams - a must.
  • Experience managing channel partners, resellers, and indirect customer relationships, including driving partner enablement, engagement, and growth strategies preferred - a must.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building abilities.
  • Experience conducting Executive Business Reviews and managing customer success plans.
  • Ability to analyse customer usage trends and translate data into actionable business insights.

Founded in early 2010, Webbing is a global data MVNO that delivers enterprise grade, global connectivity and IoT services across more than 200 countries and 600+ mobile carriers' networks. Webbing's secured network delivers network protection and web content intelligence.

Enterprise customers can manage, monitor, and optimize data usage in real-time with Webbing's powerful software platform. Gain visibility by application type and have the power to white list applications and limit non-business applications with the click of a button, saving money and improving compliance.

Responsible for facilitating and leading the design, development and integration of new or improved UKG product capabilities in collaboration with Product Management, Service Optimization and Product Engineering organizations. Responsible for the assessment of business requirements; collection and identification of specifications; and the subsequent development of solutions that require development to configuration and testing.

Provides vision and create solutions that meet current and future business requirements; prove the feasibility of a design; create the design artifacts that are required to deliver and to maintain the configuration; guide a solution through to its completion; and ultimately can be implemented and supported in production, as well as relevant to the business end users.

1. Knows, understands, incorporates, and demonstrates the Trinity Health Mission, Vision, and Values in behaviors, practices, and decisions.

2. Establishes and documents UKG product specific standards, near/mid-term strategy, and roadmaps in support of Trinity standards and strategy, acting as product specific subject matter expert.

20. 2. Five (5) years of progressive experience with comprehensive knowledge of UKG/Kronos hardware, software, application, and systems engineering in at least two (2) IT disciplines (i.e., as strategic planning, solution architecture, technology architecture, network management, security management, change management, application development, middleware design, information analysis, database management, project management and operations management).

    • Developing data enhancement processes and applications
    • Developing and integrating standard structures, processes, and delivery methods, and other comprehensive end user solutions

Join Manulife's Relationship Management team as a Bilingual Relationship Consultant, where you'll play a key role in strengthening relationships with our distribution partners across Canada for our segregated fund business.

In this role, you'll serve as a trusted relationship manager and escalation resource for Managing General Agencies (MGAs) and National Accounts (NAs). While day-to-day inquiries are supported through established service teams, you'll become involved when complex operational issues require additional coordination, investigation, or advocacy to reach resolution.

Working closely with distributors, advisors, support teams, Sales, Product, and Operations, you'll help navigate challenging situations, remove barriers, and ensure our partners receive a high-quality service experience.

In addition to relationship management and escalation support, you'll deliver training and education on Manulife tools, processes, and programs, while providing valuable distributor insights to support projects, process improvements, and business initiatives.

Success in this role comes from building trusted relationships, collaborating across teams, solving problems, and championing the distributor experience.

This role includes occasional travel and offers opportunities for growth, learning, and meaningful impact while helping make decisions easier and lives better.

Position Responsibilities:

Distributor Partnership Management

  • Manage relationships with assigned Key Accounts and Tier 1-3 MGAs/NAs, acting as a trusted operational partner.

  • Serve as an escalation resource for distributors when issues cannot be resolved through established support channels.

  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to investigate, communicate, and resolve complex operational issues.

  • Advocate on behalf of distributors and advisors while balancing business requirements and operational standards.

  • Demonstrate a deep understanding of distributor needs and proactively communicate changes to programs, tools, and processes.

  • Identify recurring issues, trends, and opportunities to improve the distributor experience.

  • Deliver training and enablement sessions to support awareness and adoption of Manulife tools and processes.

  • Participate in tier-based meetings, conferences, and relationship-building activities.

  • Leverage strong knowledge of segregated fund products and related operational processes to support distributors in resolving complex issues.

Relationship Building:

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with distributors and internal stakeholders

  • Establish trust through responsiveness, active listening, and a commitment to finding solutions.

  • Work collaboratively across Operations, Sales, Product, Compliance, and Technology teams to support distributor needs.

  • Manage escalated concerns professionally and constructively, ensuring partners remain informed throughout the resolution process.

  • Influence positive change through feedback, relationship management, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Identify and escalate potential business or compliance risks where appropriate.

Project Engagement:

  • Represent the distributor/advisor perspective in small to medium-sized projects to ensure their needs and experiences are considered throughout planning and execution.

  • Represent the distributor and advisor perspective in small to mid-sized projects, ensuring their needs are reflected in planning and execution.

  • Contribute to key communication deliverables (e.g., eNewsletters, Dealer Bulletins), ensuring messaging resonates with partners.

We are building next-generation AI infrastructure that gives enterprises access to high-performance GPU compute with speed, flexibility, and reliability. Our technical teams design and deploy sophisticated GPU clusters across data center environments, and we are looking for an architect who can turn demanding customer requirements into robust, buildable infrastructure. Confidential Employer.

  • Design high-performance network fabrics using InfiniBand, RoCE, and high-speed Ethernet based on workload and performance requirements.

  • Develop hot and cold sparing strategies designed to meet contracted availability and SLA commitments.
  • Adapt cluster designs to site-specific power, cooling, space, hardware, and deployment constraints.
  • Partner with data center teams to account for real-world facility limitations when finalizing technical architecture.
  • Work with Supply Chain to ensure architecture decisions align with realistic hardware availability and lead times.

  • Maintain technical ownership of architecture decisions while balancing performance, availability, cost, schedule, and operational supportability.

Qualifications

  • Deep working knowledge of NVIDIA Reference Architecture and GPU cluster design principles.
  • Hands-on experience designing InfiniBand, RoCE, and/or high-speed Ethernet fabrics.
  • Proven experience designing GPU or HPC clusters rather than solely consuming cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience developing sparing and spares strategies for mission-critical infrastructure.
  • Experience integrating firewalls, VPNs, dedicated circuits, protected optical connectivity, and related networking requirements into infrastructure designs.
  • Experience with high-speed shared storage technologies such as Weka, VAST Data, or DDN.
  • Strong understanding of compute, storage, networking, and data center infrastructure dependencies.
  • Ability to translate complex customer requirements into complete, practical, buildable technical architectures.
  • Strong cross-functional communication and documentation skills.
  • Experience supporting enterprise customers or neocloud deployments is preferred.
  • NVIDIA NCP program or certification experience is a plus.
  • Experience with capacity planning or sparing modeling tools is a plus.

Why You Will Love Working Here

  • Own architecture decisions that directly influence performance, reliability, scalability, and customer success.
  • Gain exposure to cutting-edge NVIDIA GPU architectures and high-speed networking technologies.

jobs.description:
TTM Technologies, Inc. – Publicly Traded US Company, NASDAQ (TTMI) – Top-5 Global Printed Circuit Board Manufacturer

About TTM

TTM Technologies, Inc. is a leading global manufacturer of technology products, including mission systems, radio frequency (“RF”) components, RF microwave/microelectronic assemblies, and technologically advanced printed circuit boards (“PCB”s). TTM stands for time-to-market, representing how TTM's time-critical, one-stop design, engineering and manufacturing services enable customers to reduce the time required to develop new products and bring them to market.

Additional information can be found at www.ttm.com

Please note that we prefer the ideal candidate to be located on Central or Mountain Time zones.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an accomplished Manager of HR Shared Services who brings a people-first mindset, an unwavering commitment to service excellence, and the operational expertise to lead a high-performing, centralized HR service delivery function.. In this role, you will serve as a champion of the employee experience — ensuring that every touchpoint with HR Shared Services, whether a routine transaction, a complex inquiry, or a sensitive life event, is handled with accuracy, care, and a genuine commitment to service excellence across our North America and EMEA employee populations.

You will be accountable for fostering a team culture where customer service is not an afterthought, but a standard — one that is upheld consistently across every employee population we serve.

Achieving that standard requires the right foundation. This role is also critical to building and sustaining a scalable, technology-enabled HR operations model that supports consistent, efficient service delivery at scale. The ideal candidate brings strong working knowledge of HR systems, a passion for process optimization, and the leadership skills to drive operational excellence across the full employee lifecycle — leveraging technology as an enabler of a better employee experience.

A key dimension of this role is the close, ongoing partnership with Payroll and COE leadership to ensure that HR processing activities and employee data transactions are seamlessly connected, accurate, and compliant — and that every employee interaction reflects a unified, well-coordinated experience from hire to retire.

This role will report to the Sr. Director, HR Shared Services & Projects.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Service Delivery & Operations

  • Oversee the day-to-day operations of the HR Shared Services Center (HRSSC), ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant delivery of HR services across all business units.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex, sensitive, or system-related HR transactions and inquiries.
  • Ensure all HR processes and transactions comply with federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations.
  • Partner with HR COEs (Total Rewards, Talent Management, HRIS, etc.), Legal, and Finance teams to resolve compliance issues and maintain seamless cross-functional workflows.

Systems Proficiency & Partnership

  • Develop and maintain deep working knowledge of core HR systems — including the HRIS (e.g., Workday), case management platforms (e.g., Workday Help), and employee self-service portals — to effectively support and guide the team in day-to-day system usage.
  • Serve as a knowledgeable partner and key business stakeholder to HR Technology and IT teams, providing operational input on system configurations, workflow changes, and enhancements that impact HR Shared Services delivery.
  • Actively participate in system implementations, upgrades, and migrations as a business representative, contributing process knowledge, testing support, and change management coordination on behalf of HR Shared Services.
  • Collaborate with HR Technology to communicate system issues, enhancement requests, and user feedback gathered from the HR Shared Services team, ensuring operational needs are represented in system decisions.
  • Champion the adoption of automation, AI-assisted tools, and self-service capabilities within the HR Shared Services function, partnering with HR Technology to identify and prioritize opportunities that reduce manual effort and improve response times.
  • Promote a culture of systems literacy across the HR Shared Services team, ensuring staff are well-trained, confident, and consistent in their use of HR platforms and tools.
  • Provide input into the evaluation of emerging HR technologies from an operational and end-user perspective, helping HR Technology and leadership assess the potential impact on service delivery.

Process Design & Continuous Improvement

  • Own the design, documentation, and continuous improvement of all HR Shared Services processes, including onboarding, offboarding, job changes, benefits administration, leaves of absence, and employee records management.
  • Build and maintain a comprehensive library of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process maps, and knowledge base articles to ensure consistency and compliance across all transactions.
  • Apply process improvement methodologies to identify inefficiencies, eliminate redundancies, and streamline workflows.
  • Establish and monitor Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and operational dashboards to measure team performance and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Lead regular process audits to ensure alignment with current policies, compliance requirements, and best practices.
  • Drive adoption of tiered service delivery models (Tier 0 self-service, Tier 1 transactional, Tier 2 complex inquiries) to optimize resource allocation and employee experience.

Metrics Monitoring & Analytics

  • Own the development and ongoing management of a comprehensive HR Shared Services metrics framework, encompassing transaction volumes, case resolution times, SLA adherence, error rates, employee satisfaction scores, and first-contact resolution rates.
  • Build and maintain real-time operational dashboards using HRIS and case management reporting tools to provide leadership with continuous visibility into team performance and service delivery health.
  • Conduct regular analysis of case and call center data to identify trends, anomalies, and root causes of service gaps — translating findings into targeted corrective actions and process improvements.
  • Establish a monthly and quarterly metrics review cadence with HR Operations leadership to assess performance against established benchmarks and align on priorities.
  • Track and report on payroll-adjacent HR transaction accuracy rates (e.g., job change processing, termination timeliness, leave of absence coding) and partner with Payroll to address data quality issues before they impact pay.
  • Leverage workforce and operational data to develop predictive insights around peak processing periods, staffing needs, and service demand fluctuations.
  • Prepare data-driven recommendations for myHRS Leader to support strategic planning, resource allocation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Monitor employee and manager satisfaction with HR Shared Services through surveys, case feedback, and qualitative inputs — using results to refine service delivery approaches and communication strategies.

Payroll Partnership & Processing Alignment

  • Cultivate and maintain a strategic, collaborative partnership with Payroll leadership to ensure seamless alignment between HR Shared Services and payroll processing activities.
  • Serve as the primary HR point of contact for Payroll on all matters related to employee data transactions, job changes, new hires, terminations, leave of absence processing, and compensation updates — ensuring changes are communicated accurately and within established payroll deadlines.
  • Jointly develop and maintain cross-functional process maps and SOPs with Payroll leadership that clearly define roles, responsibilities, handoff points, and escalation paths between HR Shared Services and Payroll.
  • Partner with Payroll leadership to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve processing errors or data discrepancies in the HRIS that may impact payroll accuracy or employee pay.
  • Collaborate with Payroll on the design and optimization of HRIS workflows and system integrations that connect HR transactions to payroll processing, minimizing manual intervention and reducing the risk of errors.
  • Establish a regular cadence of joint operational reviews with Payroll leadership to assess processing volumes, SLA performance, open issues, and upcoming changes that may impact either team.
  • Partner with Payroll to develop and deliver clear, timely employee communications around pay-related changes, open enrollment impacts, leave of absence pay implications, and other payroll-adjacent matters to ensure a consistent and transparent employee experience.
  • Proactively engage Payroll leadership in change management planning for any HR system changes, process redesigns, or organizational events (e.g., acquisitions, RIFs, large-scale hiring) that have downstream payroll impact.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing HR Shared Services team, building strong technical proficiency in HR systems and process execution.
  • Establish clear performance expectations with an emphasis on accuracy, process adherence, and systems competency.
  • Foster a culture of continuous learning by providing ongoing training on system updates, process changes, and HR technology best practices.
  • Attract and retain top talent with a focus on individuals who are both people-oriented and technically skilled.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of progressive HR experience, with at least 3-4 years in an HR Shared Services or HR Operations leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering HR services to a geographically dispersed employee population, including experience supporting employees across North America and EMEA.

Preferred

  • Master's degree in HR, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Proven experience with HR case management and ticketing systems (ServiceNow, Workday Help, etc.).
  • Strong track record of leading process improvement initiatives that resulted in measurable efficiency gains.
  • Experience participating in HRIS implementations or system migrations as a business stakeholder or subject matter expert.
  • Hands-on experience with payroll systems such as ADP Workforce Now, ADP Vantage, etc.— including an understanding of how HRIS data flows into payroll processing.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven HR service delivery platforms.
  • Experience operating in a multi-state or global HR Shared Services environment, with awareness of EMEA employment practices, data privacy requirements (e.g., GDPR), and regional service delivery considerations.
  • Experience building and presenting HR metrics reports and dashboards.
  • Working knowledge of federal and state employment laws and HR compliance requirements.
  • Solid understanding of HR data governance, data integrity practices, and system controls.
  • Strong project management proficiency with experience leading cross-functional HR initiatives.

Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, 401K, Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, accident benefits, life insurance, disability benefits, paid vacation & holidays. jobs.description:
Candidate Experience Specialist

Why First Student?

At First Student, we are committed to providing safe, reliable transportation while supporting the people who make that possible. Our teams work together to create a positive experience for employees from their very first interaction with us.

We are now hiring a Candidate Experience Specialist to help guide new hires through the final stages of the recruiting and onboarding process.

About the Role

As a Candidate Experience Specialist, you’ll serve as the primary point of contact for candidates after they receive an offer through the start of their in-person training.

You’ll help new hires complete required paperwork, background and compliance requirements, and training while keeping them informed and engaged throughout the process. You’ll also work closely with Recruiting, HR, Training, Safety, Employment Standards, and Operations to make sure candidates are ready to begin their new role.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys helping people, staying organized, solving problems, and keeping multiple priorities moving at once.

What We Offer

  • $33.00/hr
  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Paid time off and company holidays
  • Employee assistance and wellness resources
  • Opportunities for professional development and advancement
  • A collaborative team environment where your work directly impacts the candidate and employee experience

What You’ll Do

  • Guide candidates through the onboarding process from official offer through the start of in-person training
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for new hires, answering questions and providing timely updates
  • Help candidates complete required hiring documents, background checks, and compliance requirements
  • Schedule candidates for remote, onsite, or hybrid training as appropriate
  • Ensure candidates are prepared for their first day of training at their assigned location
  • Track candidate progress and maintain accurate information within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and other company systems
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition, HR, Employment Standards, Training, Safety, and Operations to resolve onboarding issues and prevent delays
  • Coordinate with training teams and location leaders regarding candidate schedules and readiness
  • Proactively follow up with candidates to maintain engagement throughout the onboarding process
  • Monitor onboarding completion, training readiness, time-to-hire, and other key performance indicators
  • Identify trends, bottlenecks, or potential delays and take action to keep candidates moving forward
  • Stay current on hiring processes, systems, compliance requirements, and best practices
  • Support process improvements that make onboarding more efficient and improve the candidate experience
  • Perform additional duties as needed to support the team and organization

What You’ll Bring

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • At least 1 year of experience in customer service, recruiting, onboarding, Human Resources, or a related field
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment
  • Strong customer service and relationship-building skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple candidates, deadlines, and priorities at the same time
  • A strong sense of urgency and the ability to follow through
  • Comfort working with Applicant Tracking Systems, CRM platforms, or similar systems
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with teams across the organization

Work Environment

  • Remote work environment with the ability to use standard office equipment
  • Minimal travel to company locations may be required for meetings, training, or other business needs

Apply Today

If you’re organized, people-focused, and enjoy helping candidates successfully navigate the hiring process, we want to hear from you.

Join First Student and help us create a smooth, welcoming onboarding experience that gets new employees off to the right start.

Apply today to become a Candidate Experience Specialist with First Student.

First Student is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Language Requirement
This role requires English proficiency. Federal, state, and local requirements, including U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations, require training, safety communications, company policies, employment documents, and other job-related communications be conducted in English.


First for a reason:

At First Student, we are a family of 60,000+ employees who take pride in safely transporting more than 5 million students and passengers to and from their destinations each day! Our family of brands include Transco, Total Transportation, Maggies Paratransit, and GVC II. Our employees are at the forefront of safety and innovation; they create and implement the most advanced training and technology the transportation industry has to offer.

Who We Are

Point32Health is a leading not-for-profit health and well-being organization dedicated to delivering high-quality, affordable healthcare. Serving nearly 2 million members, Point32Health builds on the legacy of Harvard Pilgrim Health Care and Tufts Health Plan to provide access to care and empower healthier lives for everyone. Our culture revolves around being a community of care and having shared values that guide our behaviors and decisions. We’ve had a long-standing commitment to inclusion and equal healthcare access and outcomes, regardless of background; it’s at the core of who we are. We value the rich mix of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all of our colleagues, which helps us to provide service with empathy and better understand and meet the needs of the communities where we serve, live, and work.

We enjoy the important work we do every day in service to our members, partners, colleagues and communities. Learn more about who we are at Point32Health.

Job Summary

The MassHealth Eligibility Representative will support the MassHealth Eligibility Assistance Program by providing guidance and enrollment assistance to individuals who may be eligible for MassHealth Standard, the Frail Elder Waiver, and/or CommonHealth and who may qualify for Tufts Health Plan Senior Care Options (SCO) or One Care. This role is responsible for educating seniors, adults with disabilities, and their caregivers on MassHealth eligibility requirements, Medicare coverage, benefits, and available program options within an assigned territory. The representative will assist individuals in navigating the MassHealth and Medicare enrollment processes, helping them obtain and maintain the coverage necessary to access healthcare services and qualify for integrated care programs.

This position supports membership growth for both SCO and One Care by identifying qualified prospects, generating referrals, and developing a pipeline of potential members. The MassHealth Eligibility Representative will assist individuals with MassHealth applications, provide guidance on Medicare enrollment when needed, and support other eligibility-related processes that facilitate successful enrollment into the program that best meets the member's needs.

The MassHealth Eligibility Representative is accountable for achieving monthly enrollment and lead generation goals and must be able to work independently in a fast-paced environment while effectively serving culturally and linguistically diverse populations and their caregivers.
