jobs.excerpt: Job Description Où vous travaillerez : n'importe où au Québec Lesproduits & l’ingénierie chez GoToNous sommes les pionniers de la technologie du travail à distance.
jobs.description:
Job Description

Où vous travaillerez : n'importe où au Québec

Lesproduits & l’ingénierie chez GoTo

Nous sommes les pionniers de la technologie du travail à distance. Notre mission est de concevoir des logiciels de travail innovants et flexibles qui offrent à chacun la possibilité de vivre pleinement, au travail et ailleurs. En rejoignant notre équipe, vous serez encouragé à explorer de nouvelles idées, à repousser les limites et à relever des défis passionnants. Vos compétences et votre créativité contribueront à créer des solutions qui seront utilisées par des millions d'utilisateurs à travers le monde. Il s’agit là d’une occasion unique de voir l’impact concret de votre travail et d’aider à façonner la façon dont nos clients collaborent et interagissent à distance.

Votre Quotidien

En tant que Développeur de données senior, niveau 2 vous travaillerez sur :

  • Architecture des lakehouses : Vous concevrez et construirez des pipelines ETL/ELT robustes et évolutifs sur la plateforme Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog), qui traiteront des données provenant de sources variées et serviront des équipes de toute l’entreprise.
  • Tests et ingénierie de la qualité : Vous servirez de modèle en matière de logiciels bien conçus et rigoureusement testés : vous bâtirez des suites de tests unitaires, d’intégration et de qualité des données automatisés pour les pipelines, les intégrerez à l’intégration et au déploiement continus (CI/CD) et favoriserez une culture où les essais occupent une place centrale.
  • Excellence opérationnelle : Vous serez responsable de la fiabilité de notre plateforme de données en production (surveillance, alertes, observabilité et ententes sur les niveaux de service en matière de données) : vous dirigerez les enquêtes sur les incidents jusqu’à cerner leur cause fondamentale, établirez des mesures préventives et concevrez des systèmes aptes à prévenir les incidents.
  • Ingénierie et leadership accélérés par l’IA : Vous défendrez l’utilisation responsable des outils d’IA pour accélérer notre façon de développer (développement, tests et exploitation des pipelines assistés par l’IA), tout en formant les ingénieurs à la conception de systèmes et à l’évolution des normes, notamment en matière de CI/CD et de documentation.

Ce que nous cherchons

En tant que Développeur de données senior, niveau 2, votre expérience ressemblera à

  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering or software development, with a proven record of designing, operating, and owning production-grade data pipelines end to end
  • Significant hands-on experience with the Databricks platform—Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog—along with strong Python and SQL skills
  • Significant experience testing data systems: automated unit and integration testing for pipelines, data quality frameworks and validation checks, and CI/CD for data workloads
  • Strong operational excellence track record: monitoring and observability, leading incident management to root cause, and building preventative measures into design
  • Hands-on adoption of AI tools to accelerate engineering work (development, testing, operations), plus excellent communication skills and experience mentoring engineers

Ce que nous offrons

Chez GoTo, nous croyons qu’il est important de soutenir nos employés avec une gamme complète d’avantages conçus pour s’adapter à votre vie, au travail comme ailleurs. Voici seulement quelques-uns des avantages auxquels vous pouvez vous attendre en rejoignant notre équipe :

  • Prestations de santé complètes, assurance vie et invalidité, programmes d’aide à la fertilité et à la constitution d’une famille;

  • Congés et vacances payés généreux, congés pour bénévolat, journées de bien-être personnel trimestrielles et journées sans réunions;

  • Programmes de remboursement des frais de scolarité et de lecture pour appuyer votre formation continue et votre développement professionnel;

  • Programme de bien-être Thrive Global, programme confidentiel d’aide aux employés (PAE), encadrement individuel en matière de bien-être;

  • Programmes pour les employés – dont des groupes de ressources pour les employés (GRE), le programme « GoTo s’implique » et notre programme de jumelage des dons de bienfaisance – permettant d’amplifier votre réseau social et les bienfaits de vos actions.

  • Un régime enregistré d’épargne-retraite (REER) pour vous aider à planifier votre avenir.

  • Des programmes de remboursement des frais de gym pour favoriser votre bien-être physique.

  • L’accès à des services de télémédecine pour un accès pratique aux soins de santé.

  • Un programme de primes au rendement GoTo pour célébrer votre implication et vos contributions.

  • Une allocation mensuelle de travail à distance pour couvrir les frais de votre bureau à domicile.

*** Langue de travail pour les postes situés au Québec

La connaissance du français est requise pour les postes situés en permanence au Québec afin que le titulaire puisse communiquer au besoin avec ses collègues, les partenaires et les fournisseurs au Québec. Une formation en français est offerte à tout titulaire d’un poste permanent au Québec qui ne possède pas une bonne connaissance du français.

*** Autres exigences linguistiques

La maîtrise de l’anglais est requise pour ce poste afin de communiquer avec les collègues, les clients et les partenaires (ou les fournisseurs) qui sont majoritairement situés à l’extérieur du Québec. Pour les postes en recherche et développement, il est également nécessaire de comprendre la documentation technique et scientifique de notre industrie disponible majoritairement en anglais.

Chez GoTo, vous trouverez la flexibilité, les ressources et le soutien dont vous avez besoin pour vous épanouir au travail, à la maison et partout ailleurs. Vous travaillerez à la réalisation d’un objectif commun avec une équipe ouverte d’esprit et unie dont l’impact est plus grand que la somme de ses parties. Nous nous engageons à créer un espace inclusif pour tous, parce que nous savons que ces perspectives uniques font de nous une entreprise et une communauté plus forte. Joignez-vous à nous pour faire partie d’une entreprise qui investit dans votre avenir. Ensemble, nous serons authentiques, nous verrons grand, nous avancerons rapidement, nous grandirons continuellement et nous maintiendrons notre priorité client.En savoir plus.

Where you’ll work: anywhere in Quebec

Engineering at GoTo

We’re trailblazers in remote work technology—building powerful, flexible solutions that empower everyone to live their best life, both at work and beyond. With us, you’ll have the opportunity to chart new paths and help redefine how the world works. For us, AI isn’t just a buzzword; it’s a tool we use to deliver real, practical value to our customers and teams. We focus on solving meaningful problems, not just adding features for the sake of using AI. Here, growth takes many forms: you can expand your skills, take on new challenges, lead initiatives, and explore creative ideas. Join a GoTo product team and play a key role in transforming the workplace for millions of users worldwide—your work will truly make a difference.

Your Day to Day

As a Staff Data Developer you would be working on :

  • Pipeline Development — You will build robust, scalable ETL/ELT pipelines on the Databricks platform (Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog) that process data from diverse sources, writing well-crafted, reliable, and maintainable code.
  • Testing & Quality — You will write well-tested software: automated unit, integration, and data quality tests for every pipeline you ship, embedded in CI/CD, and provide thoughtful feedback on technical solutions through code reviews.
  • Operational Excellence — You will help run our data platform in production—implementing monitoring, alerting, and data quality checks, confidently leading incident investigations to root cause, and deriving corrective actions.
  • AI-Accelerated Engineering — You will use AI tools to accelerate your development, testing, and operations work, identify opportunities to enhance team productivity with AI, and share learnings with teammates while mentoring colleagues.

What We’re Looking For

As a Staff Data Developer, your background will look like

  • 4+ years of experience in data engineering or software development, with hands-on ownership of production data pipelines
  • Hands-on experience with the Databricks platform or Apache Spark—including Delta Lake and data lake management—along with strong Python and SQL skills
  • Significant experience testing data systems: automated unit and integration tests for pipelines, data quality validation, and working with CI/CD
  • Experience operating pipelines in production: monitoring, alerting, and participating in or leading incident investigations to root cause
  • Effective use of AI tools in daily engineering work, plus strong communication skills and the ability to mentor colleagues in an agile team

What We Offer

At GoTo, we believe in supporting our employees with a comprehensive range of benefits designed to fit your life—at work and beyond. Here are just some of the benefits and perks you can expect when you join our team

  • Comprehensive health benefits, life and disability insurance, and fertility and family-forming support programs
  • Generous paid time off, paid holidays, volunteer time off, and quarterly self-care days and no meeting days
  • Tuition and reading reimbursement programs to support your continuous learning and professional growth
  • Thrive Global Wellness Program, confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP), as well as One to One Wellness Coaching
  • Employee programs—including Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), GoTo Gives, and our charitable matching program—to amplify your connection and impact.
  • Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) to help you plan for your future
  • Gym reimbursement programs to encourage your physical well-being
  • Access to telemedicine services for convenient healthcare support
  • GoTo performance bonus program to celebrate your impact and contributions
  • Monthly remote work stipend to support your home office expenses

*** Working language for positions in Quebec

Knowledge of French is required for permanent positions in Quebec, to enable the incumbent to communicate as needed with colleagues, partners and suppliers in Quebec. French-language courses are offered to any incumbent of a permanent position in Quebec who does not have a good knowledge of French.

*** Other language requirements

Fluency in English is required for this position in order to communicate with colleagues, customers and partners (or suppliers) who are mostly located outside Quebec. For positions in research and development, it is also necessary to understand the technical and scientific documentation of our industry, most of which is available in English.

At GoTo, you’ll find the flexibility, resources, and support you need to thrive—at work, at home, and everywhere in between. You’ll work towards a shared goal with an open-minded, cohesive team that’s greater than the sum of its parts. We’re committed to creating an inclusive space for everyone, because we know unique perspectives make us a stronger company and community. Join us and be part of a company that invests in your future, where together we’ll Be Real, Think Big, Move Fast, Keep Growing, and stay Customer Obsessed. Learn more.

jobs.description:
Staff PRODUCT ENGINEER (Contract)

Build it. Ship it. Own it.

Location: Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, Chile, Mexico, Dominican Republic, Peru

About Counterpart

Counterpart is an insurtech platform reimagining management and professional liability for the modern workplace. We believe that when businesses lead with clarity and confidence, they become more resilient, more innovative, and better prepared for what's ahead. That's why we built the first Agentic Insurance™ system — where advanced AI and deep insurance expertise come together to proactively assess, mitigate, and manage risk. Backed by A-rated carriers and trusted by brokers nationwide, our platform helps small businesses grow with confidence. Join us in shaping a smarter future, helping businesses Do More With Less Risk®.

The Role

As a Product Engineer at Counterpart, you own problems and drive outcomes. You iron out requirements with stakeholders, partners, and customers. You leverage AI for implementation. You verify the end-to-end result. You iterate until you move the needle.

You run projects with other Product Engineers and AI agents. You know when to delegate to a human, when to delegate to an agent, and when to do it yourself.

YOU WILL

Own the Problem

  • Take accountability for the outcome.
  • Talk directly to your users, stakeholders, and peers to discover the problem.
  • Translate business intents into functional requirements that engineers and agents can build against. Determine where human judgment is non-negotiable and where AI can augment or act autonomously.
  • Own the non-functional technical requirements. Specify the quality bar: performance, scalability, reliability, security, maintainability.

Build with AI

  • Write production-quality code across the stack: Python, Django, AWS, React, and PostgreSQL. You are not afraid of any layer.
  • Direct agents and review their output with domain depth. Catch what they miss across the functional and non-functional bar: correctness, edge cases, performance, security, testability, readability.
  • Evaluate and improve agent output regularly. Track failure modes. Refine the prompts and patterns that lift the quality ceiling over time.
  • Run projects that span other Product Engineers and agents. Coordinate work, manage dependencies, and keep things moving without micromanaging.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions. Bring options and alternatives, not objections. Know when the elegant solution is the wrong call for a startup moving fast.
  • Contribute to and manage the context harness as you build and deliver.

Verify and Iterate

  • Surface delivery risks early. Bring solutions, not just problems. Keep your stakeholders informed without turning every risk into a meeting.
  • Verify the end-to-end result yourself. Confirm the system does what the requirements say, and that the requirements were right.
  • Drive adoption of what you ship. Documentation, enablement, and usage monitoring are part of the job.
  • Monitor your services in production. Own the signal. Debug and fix what breaks.
  • Participate in support rotations. When users run into issues with what you shipped, you investigate and fix them.
  • Iterate until you move the needle. Shipping is not the finish line. Outcome is.

Raise the Bar

  • Mentor engineers around you. Give direct, useful feedback. Leave things better than you found them.
  • Make deliberate calls on technical debt: when to accumulate it, when to pay it down, when to refactor. Translate trade-offs into language that business leaders can act on.
  • Operate to the engineering standards for quality, reliability, and operational excellence.

YOU HAVE

  • 10+ years building production web applications across the full stack. The years are the floor, not the bar. What matters is whether you have actually done this: owned a problem end-to-end, written the spec, built the thing, coordinated the work, and shipped it without someone else holding the thread.
  • Demonstrated experience gathering requirements directly. You have interviewed users, customers, and partner teams, and turned ambiguous intent into specs that engineers and agents can build against.
  • Demonstrated experience owning both functional and non-functional requirements. You have defined what a system must do and held the line on how well it must do it.
  • A track record of owning a domain or initiative without close supervision. You have navigated ambiguity, made judgment calls, and been accountable for the outcome.
  • Extreme ownership and a bias for action. You do not sit and wait. You chase stakeholders, customers, and answers when you need them.
  • Experience coordinating across engineers and AI agents on a shared initiative. You have managed the work without holding a formal management title.
  • Strong technical judgment and the depth to catch what AI-generated code gets wrong: not syntax, but correctness, architecture, intent.
  • Proficiency with Python and Django. Working knowledge of TypeScript, React, and PostgreSQL.
  • Proficiency in developing with AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, similar) and the drive to stay ahead of how AI development practices are evolving.
  • Domain curiosity. You learn the business context your work supports, not just the systems. You understand why the problem matters, not just how to solve it.
  • The ability to communicate clearly across engineering, product, and business, translating technical complexity without losing meaning.
  • Low ego and high Emotional Quotient (EQ). You influence without authority, take feedback well, and leave your ego out of technical decisions.
  • Experience working with distributed, remote teams.

HOW THIS ROLE WORKS

Product Engineering exists to collapse the distance between a problem and a working solution. You own a problem or part of a vision. You shape it with stakeholders. You build it with AI. You verify it end-to-end. You iterate until the metric moves.

You work within the Context Architecture, a shared system of documentation, design patterns, and domain knowledge that gives you the technical context to make autonomous decisions at every step.

This is not a role for engineers who need to be told how. It is a role for engineers who can take a problem, fill in the gaps with good judgment, and ship something that works.

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH

  • Derrick Franco, Principal Engineer: After teaching himself to code at 13, Derrick went on to co-found Jumpstart in addition to building out the technical divisions at InvestorsAlley and Phinaz Media Group. Nowadays Derrick spends his time reading, with his wife, and working on his podcast The Future of Work Project.
  • Julian Prokay, Principal Engineer: A veteran of the SaaS space with experience working on both student systems and construction management software. In his free time, he enjoys history podcasts and fantasy literature.
  • Tony Nguyen, Engineering Manager: Tony is an engineering and platform leader with 25+ years of leadership experience at companies like Sony PlayStation Network, Intuit TurboTax, and ServiceNow. He thrives at building products, scaling teams, and leading organizations, but more so building people. He believes the best leadership and engineering comes from bringing your full identity to work. For him that's faith, family, and sports! Outside of work, you can catch him on the couch with his 3 adult children watching anime, going to Disneyland, or having game nights.
  • Ron Alexessen, Engineering Manager: With experience at Hewlett-Packard, New Relic, Rackspace, and consulting agencies, Ron has built teams and shaped technical culture across different environments. He's passionate about AI-enabled development as a force multiplier and building solutions that create real business impact. Outside work, he boulders, runs, rides gravel bikes, and co-parents active teenagers, embracing structured chaos in all of it.
  • Newton Truong, Engineering Manager: Newton joins Counterpart with 7+ years of experience in platform and data engineering. In his last company Thrive Market, he had a hand in building out new microservices and architecting data pipelines with Airflow and Spark. He's vegetarian and loves trying new restaurants when traveling. Nowadays he's busy keeping up with his 2-year-old and doing outdoor activities with his family.
  • John Mendez, Engineering Manager: John has experience working at companies of all sizes. He enjoys startups and small-to-medium businesses, where he can wear multiple hats and help deliver solutions. Outside of work, he stays busy with his four kids and their activities. He also makes time to stay active by working out at home and running or walking with his dog.

COUNTERPART'S VALUES

  • Conjoin Expectations - it is the cornerstone of autonomy. Ensure you are aware of what is expected of you and clearly articulate what you expect of others.
  • Speak Boldly & Honestly - the only failure is not learning from mistakes. Don't cheat yourself and your colleagues of the feedback needed when expectations aren't being met.
  • Be Entrepreneurial - control your own destiny. Embrace action over perfection while navigating any obstacles that stand in the way of your ultimate goal. Leverage AI ruthlessly. We measure success by outcomes, not lines of code written. Use every available AI tool to ship faster and think more strategically.
  • Practice Omotenashi ("selfless hospitality") - trust will follow. Consider every interaction with internal and external partners an opportunity to develop trust by going above and beyond what is expected.
  • Hold Nothing As Sacred - create routines but modify them routinely. Take the time to reflect on where the business is today, where it needs to go, and what you have to change in order to get there.
  • Prioritize Wellness - some things should never be sacrificed. We create an environment that stretches everyone to grow and improve, which is fulfilling, but is only one part of a meaningful life.

PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the transactional database market. The PlanetScale platform offers both Postgres and Vitess clusters.   • Create educational content including documentation, guides, blog posts, workshops, and videos.

  • You have deep expertise in database systems including replication, high availability, sharding, performance tuning, and migration strategies.

  • Contributions to open-source projects or active participation in database communities

Why PlanetScale

We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. About the role

We’re hiring a Staff Technical Product Manager to lead definition and evolution of foundational platform capabilities spanning multiple engineering organizations. This role reports directly to the CTO and operates at the system level - shaping the structures and primitives that underpin our products rather than managing feature-level roadmaps.

You will own problems that cross organizational boundaries and cannot be solved within a single team. The objective of this role is improving structural coherence across the platform - defining durable system structures and primitives, aligning stakeholders, and ensuring they translate into real capability.

Operating in close partnership with engineering leadership, this role progressively assumes independent ownership of convergence and cross-organizational decision resolution. Execution coordination is part of the role, but performance is measured by durable system improvement and structural convergence.

Example problem spaces include:

  • Authorization and policy models
  • Identity and ownership boundaries
  • Data access structures
  • Platform abstractions and shared primitives

  • Drive resolution of structural problems spanning multiple engineering organizations
  • Build alignment across engineering leadership, design, and mission stakeholders
  • Maintain convergence momentum across teams implementing shared capabilities
  • Partner with Engineering Managers to translate structural intent into execution plans and hold convergence through delivery
  • Stay engaged through delivery to ensure implementations converge on intended outcomes
  • Identify architectural divergence early and drive corrective action
  • Identify and drive resolution of cross-team dependencies arising from shared platform primitives and structural initiatives

What we’re looking for

  • Strong systems reasoning across distributed systems, identity/authorization, or platform architecture
  • Demonstrated success shaping technical direction across multiple teams

  • Credible communicator able to influence senior engineers and technical leadership across domains without relying on formal authority structures
  • High ownership mindset in ambiguous environments
  • Outstanding driver and communicator who identifies structural risks early - such as unclear ownership, missing definitions, or weak execution setup - and intervenes to correct course

Nice to have

  • Experience with policy or authorization systems
  • Multi-tenant or regulated environment exposure

jobs.title: Staff Data Scientist, NIRA
jobs.excerpt: Join the Tilt teamAt Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss.
jobs.description:
Join the Tilt team

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.

NIRA is building a consumer credit platform for Middle India, targeting ~200m underservied people. Active in 5000+ cities and processing 15,000+ loan applications/day, NIRA is backed by and integrated with US-based Tilt.

This is a hybrid role, requiring you to work in our Bangalore office 2-3 days/week.

The Opportunity: Staff Data Scientist

We’re hiring for a Staff Data Scientist to help expand Tilt’s credit modeling and risk analytics capability for our India-based business, NIRA.

This is a high impact role with a direct mandate to build and refine underwriting models as well as other models, working at the intersection of credit, data science, and leadership.

You’ll collaborate with a lean but growing team, applying advanced modeling techniques to predict loss performance, leverage alternative data sources, and build next-generation tools that shape credit access for millions.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • NIRA is undertaking a solid turn in unit economics with a view to growing to being the largest fintech in India, and this is an opportunity to build foundational credit models and features from the ground up.

  • With direct exposure to leadership, your work will shape both near-term lending performance and long-term data infrastructure.

  • You will partner directly with cross-functional teams across credit, engineering, and leadership, bringing strong project and stakeholder management skills to a lean, fast-growing team.

  • Work with alternative data where the underwriting process and modeling reflect the maturity of the market

Why You're a Great Fit

  • 7+ years of deep expertise in predictive modeling, ideally within credit risk or actuarial settings.

  • Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and ML libraries like scikit-learn, LightGBM, XGBoost.

  • Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude, Codex or agentic workflows

  • Experience building models from scratch and owning projects end-to-end

  • Strong stakeholder management skills; experience partnering with cross-functional teams to drive outcomes.

  • Clear communication skills, including the ability to present complex findings to non-technical leadership.

  • Experience working in high-growth, ambiguous environments with lean teams.

Nice-to-haves

  • Fintech experience - especially in credit/lending models or alternative underwriting.

  • Familiarity with legacy credit systems and how to modernize them.

  • Familiarity with funnel management and ways to novate reject rules into modeling outcomes

  • Exposure to the India’s credit markets and ability to transfer insights between geographies.

  • Experience with models across the loan life cycle

  • Knowledge of deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch) and modeling (CNN, RNN) — a plus but not essential.

Our Interview Process

  1. Initial Recruiter Call: A conversation to learn about your experience and what you're looking for in your next role.

  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A deeper discussion about your background and approach to solving challenges.

  3. Skills Panel: Meet with Tilt and NIRA team members to discuss your expertise and problem-solving approach through real-world scenarios.

  4. Leadership Conversation: A final conversation with our CEO to discuss our mission and how you could contribute to it (and how we can help you achieve your career goals along the way).

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What you'll get at Tilt

  • Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

  • Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

  • Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

  • Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

  • Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

  • Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

jobs.excerpt: Join us as we transform immunology and deliver medicines that help autoimmune patients get their lives back.
jobs.description:
Join us as we transform immunology and deliver medicines that help autoimmune patients get their lives back. argenx is preparing for multi-dimensional expansion to reach more patients through a rich pipeline of differentiated assets, led by VYVGART, our first-in-class neonatal Fc receptor blocker approved for the treatment of gMG, and with the potential to treat patients across dozens of severe autoimmune diseases.

We are building a new kind of biotech company, one that maintains its roots as a science-based start-up and pushes our commitment to innovate across all corners of our business. We strive to inspire and grow our company, our partnerships, our science, and our people, because when we do, we deliver more for patients.

The Franchise Clinical Operations Development Lead (CODL) is responsible for the strategizing, planning, leading and execution of the operational path for all indications within a franchise from first in human studies through authorization and commercialization. The franchise may involve several assets and/or may cover specific development phases across all assets/indications (teams specifically focusing on ph I or ph IV trials).

The Franchise CODL functions as the line manager for all the Clinical Operations Development Leads (CODLs) assigned to indications within the specific franchise or development phase specific teams.

The Franchise CODL will function as a clinical strategic operational voice for the franchise, both internally and externally. This seasoned professional will excel in leadership, people management and organizational skills.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee the CODLs who provide strategic input and are accountable for all clinical related aspects within the assigned therapeutic indication/program, in line with the agreed timelines, budget and quality standards and as outlined in the applicable Standard Operation Procedures (SOPs) and Work Instructions (WIs).

  • Oversee the Clinical development Plan (CDP) creation for all indications within the franchise. The CDP is co-created by the CODL and the Medical Development Lead (MDL), with support from the Project Manager (PM) and other Clinical Development Team (CDT) representatives. The indication CDP describes the clinical development strategy, includes effective and, where possible, innovative trial designs and is consistent with the TPP. The CDP is endorsed by the Asset Strategy Team (AST) and the Development Management Committee (DMC) and is executed within agreed timelines and budget

  • The Franchise CODL can temporarily take on the role of an CODL for an indication within the franchise. Please refer to the Job Description of the CODL for further details on the CODL role.

  • Acts as senior point of contact for all clinical related activities for a given Franchise across asset indications. Collaborate with the asset teams as applicable.

  • Focus on risks and mitigations on the franchise level. Ensures that the Global Head of Trial Operations is informed in case an identified issue/risk could have an impact on/may also occur in, the other therapeutic indications/programs / franchises. Involve the X-indication CODL, AST and PM as needed.

  • Operationalize knowhow and synergies at the franchise level, ensure knowhow is shared with different indication teams.

  • Ensure optimal implementation of lessons learnt within and across the franchises.

  • Provides input to the relevant Objectives, Goals, Strategies and Measures (OGSMs), and ensures that clinical trials are executed according to the CDPs and those OGSMs, following the argenx procedures and processes and conducted in compliance with ICH-GCP and other applicable legislation.

  • As needed, participates in the Clinical Research Organization (CRO) and vendor selection and management process. Supports CDTs and Clinical Trial Teams (CTTs) with issue resolution where required in collaboration with the CODL and alliance vendor manager, if relevant.

  • Acts as a point of escalation for resolution of trial management and operational issues within the franchise indications.

  • Reviews and provides input to the overarching clinical program/indication documents such as Investigator Brochure (IB), Pediatric Investigation Plan (PIP), FDA/PMDA/EMA and other regulatory critical documents.

  • Oversees the Indication and clinical trial budgets and timelines in collaboration with the CODLs and the Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs).

  • Oversees the resource requirements for Trial Operations within the franchise and ensures the needed resources are onboarded timely and efficiently.

  • Oversees audit/inspection readiness of the assigned program/trials. Support audits and inspections.

  • Supports continuous improvement processes and consistency. Collaborates with the knowledge hubs with the Trial Ops team.

  • As seasoned Leader, sets expectations, communicates in a transparent, clear way and energizes and motivates the CODLs and the CTMs to work towards achieving the clinical goals in line with the OGSM and argenx’s cultural pillars.

  • Act as line manager for the CODLs and leader within the Trial Ops team:

    • Interviewing candidates

    • On-boarding

    • Ensuring that assigned staff are trained

    • Goal setting and review

    • Mentoring and enabling the growth and development of assigned staff

  • Supports TrailOps and Global Company initiatives as applicable.

  • Collaborate on the franchise level with stakeholders outside of Clinical and R&D, eg Corporate Development, Science, Patient Advocacy Group (PAG), Medical Affairs and others.

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

  • The Franchise CODL excels in leadership and establishing good and effective internal and external working relationships and communication, embedding the argenx values.

  • Proven track record in relevant leadership positions, including line management, within Clinical Operations in the pharmaceutical/biotech industries.

  • Proven knowledge of planning and execution of clinical development plans and clinical trials.

  • Experience in building and leading a team with a variety of skill sets.

  • Build bridges between people, functions and regions.

  • Pro-active problem solver - demonstrated ability to identify and resolve issues, identify and mitigate risks, able to handle conflicts.

  • Strong organizational skills, able to manage multiple and varied tasks and prioritize workload with attention to the holistic/ helicopter view but also able to dive into the details when needed.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, acting globally in a culturally diverse dynamic team.

  • Strong verbal and written English communication skills (primary fluency or full professional proficiency).

  • Thorough knowledge of ICH GCP guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements and guidelines.

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE and QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree or University degree – medical or para-medical (Biology, Biomedical Sciences, Pharmacy, Veterinary etc.) or equivalent by experience. PhD degree is a plus.

  • Minimum of 15 years of leading experience in Clinical Development (monitoring, local and global/international trial management).

  • Experience in working in an outsourced model, including overseeing CROs and vendors.

  • Strategy as well as execution for clinical development.

  • Change and risk management.

  • Budget financial acumen.

  • Rare disease and/or auto-immune clinical trial background relevant to the franchise.

Intitulé du poste (H/F)

Product Marketing Manger - H/F - CDI

Rejoignez le Groupe INTESCIA, leader de la Business Intelligence en Europe !

INTESCIA est un acteur majeur dans le domaine de la data, du digital et de l’intelligence économique. Nous accompagnons les entreprises en leur fournissant des solutions innovantes pour optimiser leur gestion, leur performance financière et leur prise de décision. Rattaché au Pôle Clients, le Product Marketing Manager joue un rôle clé à la croisée des équipes Produit, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success et Revenue. Sa mission est de maximiser le succès commercial et client des offres INTESCIA, depuis leur positionnement marché jusqu’à leur acquisition, leur adoption et leur création de valeur chez les clients.

Le rôle couvre à la fois les nouveaux produits, les évolutions d’offres existantes et les contextes de migration, avec un objectif clair : accélérer la croissance, renforcer l’usage des solutions, sécuriser la rétention et soutenir l’expansion client.

Construire et faire évoluer le positionnement des solutions, offres et services Intescia.

Définir les messages clés, propositions de valeur et différenciateurs par segment, persona et cas d’usage.

Traduire les capacités produits en bénéfices clients clairs, business et activables par les équipes terrain.

Structurer et partager la connaissance des besoins, usages et irritants des segments cibles.

jobs.title: Rugby Giving Lead Consultant - ChildFund Rugby
jobs.excerpt: Application deadline: 14 August 20261.  Organisational Context ChildFund Rugby partners to use rugby as a powerful tool for positive social impact, supporting children and young people to play, learn and lead.
jobs.description:
Application deadline: 14 August 2026

1. Organisational Context

ChildFund Rugby partners to use rugby as a powerful tool for positive social impact, supporting children and young people to play, learn and lead. ChildFund Rugby is World Rugby’s global Social Impact Partner, a multi-year partnership that builds on previous partnerships across five consecutive Rugby World Cup events.

ChildFund Rugby’s partners use Pass It Back, a set of integrated rugby and life skills learning products, so that children and young people in vulnerable situations have opportunities to develop critical social and emotional skills, overcome challenges, inspire positive social change and take leadership roles in their lives.

ChildFund Rugby is establishing the Pass It Back Collective, a global community of rugby-connected supporters whose significant investment will help Pass It Back reach more children and young people. Launching with an inaugural group and growing over time, the Collective will be built through trusted introductions, individual relationship-building, meaningful engagement, major giving and long-term stewardship.

2. Purpose

The purpose of this consultancy is to develop trusted relationships with a defined portfolio of rugby-connected prospective donors and progress those relationships towards significant charitable donations to Pass It Back and long-term membership of the Pass It Back Collective.

This is a relationship-based fundraising role. The Rugby Giving Lead will combine the credibility, relationships and lived experience of an elite rugby athlete with structured training and support in donor engagement and major giving.

3. Portfolio

The Rugby Giving Lead will own a defined regional portfolio of qualified prospective donors and cultivate relevant connectors who can provide trusted introductions and open doors.

The portfolio will generally comprise approximately 25–35 prospects at different stages of qualification and cultivation. Its final composition will reflect the agreed geographic focus, prospect readiness and level of effort.

4. Scope of Services

A. Portfolio Development and Relationship Management

  • Own and actively manage an agreed portfolio of prospective supporters, maintaining clear relationship strategies, current records and next actions;
  • Draw on their rugby experience, credibility and networks, and work with trusted connectors, to secure warm introductions to priority prospective donors;
  • Build authentic relationships through individual meetings, small gatherings, rugby events, Pass It Back briefings, in-person visits and virtual experiences that enable prospective donors to understand Pass It Back’s work and impact firsthand;
  • Progress relationships through qualification, cultivation, solicitation and stewardship, regularly reviewing priorities and addressing stalled or unsuitable prospects.

B. Major Giving and Collective Development

  • Assess prospect readiness and work with the Co-Directors and fundraising advisers to develop appropriate gift strategies;
  • Prepare for, participate in and, where appropriate, lead major-gift conversations and solicitations;
  • Use selected rugby and supporter events to connect with prospective donors, facilitate introductions and progress relationships, with appropriate preparation and follow-up;
  • Follow through on prospective commitments, documentation and agreed actions;
  • Steward Collective members through meaningful communication and engagement, identifying opportunities for renewed giving, advocacy and introductions;
  • Contribute to the Pass It Back Collective’s shared membership and revenue targets through a relationship-led approach.

C. Representation and Collaboration

  • Represent ChildFund Rugby and the Pass It Back Collective confidently at selected meetings, events and supporter engagements;
  • Communicate Pass It Back’s purpose and impact clearly, drawing appropriately on personal rugby experience to build trust and connection;
  • Work closely with the Co-Directors, other Rugby Giving Leads, ChildFund Rugby Ambassadors, fundraising advisers and the Social Impact Administrator to coordinate introductions, relationship activity and supporter engagement;
  • Provide timely information for portfolio management, planning and forecasting, and brief Ambassadors and senior representatives before their involvement in prospective donor relationships;
  • Protect ChildFund Rugby’s credibility and reputation through informed, respectful and values-aligned representation.

5. Management and Reporting Arrangements

The Rugby Giving Lead will report to the ChildFund Rugby Co-Directors.

Relationship ownership, geographic scope, portfolio size, approval thresholds and solicitation responsibilities will be agreed at commencement and reviewed regularly.

6. Confidentiality

All discussions and documents relating to this ToR will be treated as confidential by the parties.The role will have access to confidential organisational, personal, donor and stakeholder information.

The successful applicant must:

  • Maintain strict confidentiality;
  • Use information only for authorised purposes;
  • Store and share records through approved systems;
  • Comply with applicable privacy, data-protection and organisational requirements;
  • Immediately report any actual or suspected loss, disclosure or misuse of information.

7. Child Safeguarding

The Consultant will be required to comply with and sign a Code of Conduct that outlines safeguarding and prevention of sexual exploitation, abuse, and harassment obligations. The Consultant will also be required to complete relevant background and/or criminal history checks.

8. Counter-Terrorism

ChildFund acknowledges its obligation under the Australian laws relating to counter-terrorism. In order to meet its obligation, the Consultant will be reviewed against the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) and National Security Australia lists at the onset of any financial relationship.

9. Acknowledgement and Disclaimer

ChildFund, its Board, and staff make no express or implied representation or warranty as to the currency, reliability, or completeness of the information contained in this ToR. Nothing in this ToR should be construed to give rise to any contractual obligations or rights, expressed or implied, by the issue of this ToR. No contract would be created until a formal written contract is executed between ChildFund and a selected Consultant.

10. Requirements

Previous fundraising or major-giving experience is not required. ChildFund Rugby will provide structured induction, training, practical resources and ongoing mentoring.

The successful applicant will demonstrate:

  • Experience as a current or former professional or elite rugby athlete, with credibility and relevant relationships within the rugby community;
  • The ability to build authentic relationships with people from different professional, cultural and personal backgrounds;
  • Strong communication, listening and storytelling skills;
  • Confidence initiating conversations and maintaining relationships through consistent personal follow-up;
  • Strong personal organisation and sound judgement, with the ability to work independently and asynchronously, use shared digital platforms effectively, and maintain timely records and follow-up;
  • Openness to learning about relationship-based fundraising and participating in significant gift conversations;
  • An authentic commitment to Pass It Back, gender equality and rugby’s potential to create positive social impact.

The following will be advantageous but are not required:

  • Established networks, additional languages or cross-cultural experience relevant to the geographic market;
  • Experience representing rugby through leadership, media, ambassador, community, governance or commercial roles;
  • Experience in relationship development, business development, partnerships or senior stakeholder engagement.

Success Criteria

Success will be demonstrated by:

  • The assigned portfolio being actively managed and progressed, with clear strategies and timely next actions;
  • Trusted introductions, meaningful conversations and appropriate major-gift opportunities being developed;
  • A material contribution to the Pass It Back Collective’s shared membership and revenue targets;
  • Collective members receiving thoughtful stewardship that supports continued engagement, renewed giving and introductions;
  • Strong collaboration, accurate reporting and consistent follow-through;
  • ChildFund Rugby and the Pass It Back Collective being represented credibly and confidently.

Portfolio-specific targets will be agreed at commencement and reviewed regularly.

11. Role Boundaries

The Rugby Giving Lead is responsible for the development, progression and stewardship of assigned relationships.

The Co-Directors retain overall responsibility for campaign strategy, organisational commitments, gift acceptance and sensitive or high-value decisions. They may participate in or lead selected solicitations.

The Social Impact Administrator will support scheduling, records, briefing materials, communications coordination and portfolio visibility. Administrative support does not replace the Rugby Giving Lead’s accountability for relationship strategy, personal follow-up and portfolio progress.

12. Other Information

Location: Remote. Initial appointments are expected to focus on North America and Europe.

Employment type: Consultancy contract.

Working arrangements: This is a part-time consultancy expected to require approximately 10–12 hours per week. Performance will be assessed primarily against agreed portfolio deliverables and relationship progress rather than fixed working hours. The Consultant will need to work flexibly, including occasional early-morning or evening meetings, to accommodate prospective donors, events and colleagues across time zones.

Travel: Domestic and international travel may be required for selected meetings, rugby events and Pass It Back experiences.

Contract term: Fixed-term consultancy, with the initial term and potential extension agreed based on availability, performance, programme requirements and funding.

13. Application Instructions

Please apply through this link, completing all requested fields and sharing a cover letter that responds to this ToR.

Applicants should submit:

  • A current CV;
  • A cover letter outlining their suitability and interest in the role;
  • A brief description of relevant rugby, professional, community or stakeholder networks;
  • Examples of relationship-building, representation, partnership or comparable experience;
  • Availability and ability to commit approximately 10–12 hours per week;
  • Proposed monthly consultancy fee for this level of commitment.

Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a short practical exercise involving preparation for a prospective-supporter meeting or drafting a follow-up communication. No previous fundraising knowledge will be required.

Application deadline: 14 August 2026

ChildFund is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and strongly encourages people from all backgrounds, abilities, and identities to apply for vacancies.

EnableComp earned its reputation in the toughest corners of the revenue cycle by solving the complex claims no one else could. We developed Complex Revenue Intelligence™ (CRI), a smarter approach to predict and prevent revenue loss. Powered by the e360 RCM® AI-driven platform and the most expansive complex revenue cycle data set, today EnableComp helps more than 1,000 hospitals nationwide recover $3 billion annually from complex claims, denials, and revenue recovery. By cutting through complexity, we help hospitals thrive, resulting in recognition as Black Book’s #1 Specialty RCM provider for complex claims and revenue integrity in 2024 and 2025, a multi-year Top Workplaces honoree, and a SOC 2 Type II and HITRUST e1-certified platform.Our Vision is to empower healthcare providers to focus on patient care, not revenue cycle complexity. Our Mission is to uncover what others miss—turning every client dollar recovered into insight that helps prevent future loss. We live our Core Values of Uncompromising Integrity, Ecstatic Clients, and Empowered Team Members by operating with trust, accountability, and a “we before me” mindset. We pursue Innovation and Profitable Growth through continuous improvement and thoughtful problem-solving, and we believe work should include Fun—celebrating success, recognizing our people, and maintaining healthy work-life balance.

POSITION SUMMARY

The GTM Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and operating the technical infrastructure that powers EnableComp's account-based demand generation motion. This role sits at the intersection of Revenue Operations and Marketing, translating buying signals, catalysts, and triggers (M&A activity, leadership changes, RCM technology contract expirations, RFP activity, hiring patterns, and other intent data) into prioritized, enriched, and routed target accounts inside HubSpot. The GTM Engineer owns the tooling, data pipelines, and workflow automation connecting Clay, HubSpot, and other GTM systems, ensuring Marketing and Sales are always working the highest-propensity accounts with accurate, enriched data and minimal manual effort.

The Job Responsibilities Include

  • Build and maintain automated workflows in Clay that identify and score ABM signals, catalysts, and triggers (e.g., executive changes, M&A, technology contract expirations, RFPs, hiring surges) across target health system and physician group accounts.
  • Partner with Marketing and Revenue Operations to design and maintain the HubSpot architecture (lists, workflows, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, and routing rules) that operationalizes signal-based account prioritization.
  • Develop and maintain integrations and data pipelines between Clay, HubSpot, enrichment/intent data providers, and internal systems (e.g., CRM, data warehouse) using APIs, webhooks, and native connectors.
  • Analyze account and contact-level data to identify patterns in signal quality, conversion, and pipeline impact, refining scoring models and enrichment logic accordingly.
  • Lead the technical build-out of net-new ABM campaigns, ensuring signal capture, enrichment, and routing logic are in place before launch.
  • Conduct regular audits of data quality, deduplication, and enrichment accuracy across HubSpot and Clay to maintain a clean, reliable source of truth for GTM teams.
  • Coordinate with Sales Development, Partnerships, and Client Services to ensure signal-qualified accounts are routed to the right owner with appropriate context and timing.
  • Evaluate new GTM tools, data providers, and automation opportunities that could improve signal detection, targeting precision, or operational efficiency.
  • Identify gaps or bottlenecks in the demand generation tech stack and workflows, and design scalable solutions in partnership with Marketing and RevOps leadership.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Education Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field required; equivalent practical experience considered
  • 3+ years of experience in a GTM Engineering, Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, or Sales Operations role, ideally within B2B SaaS or healthcare technology
  • Demonstrated hands-on expertise administering HubSpot (workflows, lists, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, reporting) in a marketing or revenue operations capacity
  • Direct experience building enrichment and signal-detection workflows in Clay, including use of formulas, integrations, and waterfall enrichment
  • Working knowledge of APIs, webhooks, and no-code/low-code automation tools (e.g., Zapier, Make) to connect GTM systems
  • Familiarity with account-based marketing (ABM) concepts, intent data providers, and B2B enterprise buying committees
  • Strong SQL or spreadsheet-based data analysis skills; comfort working with large, imperfect data sets
  • Timely and regular attendance.
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered
  • To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Special Considerations & Prerequisites

  • Minimal travel required (less than 20%), primarily for occasional team or company offsites
  • Ability to work at a computer for extended periods; standard office or remote work environment
  • A great candidate is self-directed and comfortable owning ambiguous, cross-functional problems; treats data hygiene as non-negotiable; and can translate technical workflows into plain-language impact for Sales and Marketing stakeholders
  • Practices and adheres to EnableComp’s Core Values, Vision and Mission.

All applicants will be considered for this position based upon experience and knowledge, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, marital, disabled or veteran status. We are committed to creating and maintaining a workforce environment that is free from any form of discrimination or harassment.

As the employer of choice in the complex claims industry, EnableComp takes pride in our continuous commitment to building and maintaining a culture centered around fostering the professional growth and development of our people. We believe that investing in our employees is the key to our success, and we are dedicated to providing them with the tools, resources, and support they need to thrive and grow their career here. At EnableComp, we are committed to living up to our core values each and every day, and we believe that this commitment is what sets us apart from other companies. If you are looking for a company that values its employees and is dedicated to helping them achieve their full potential, then EnableComp is the place for you.

jobs.excerpt: Join the Tilt teamAt Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss.
jobs.description:
Join the Tilt team

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.

The Opportunity: Senior Product Designer

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to help shape the future of Tilt products. You’ll own complex, high-impact product experiences across areas such as cash management, financial wellness, transaction-related tools, and others.

This is an individual contributor role for a designer who combines strong product thinking and UX fundamentals with exceptional visual and UI craft. You’ll join a collaborative design team and work closely with product managers, engineers, and other partners to turn ambiguous opportunities into thoughtful, intuitive experiences.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Lead end-to-end design for a meaningful portion of our product ecosystem, from early exploration through launch and iteration.

  • Translate complex financial concepts and workflows into clear, approachable customer experiences.

  • Set a high bar for interaction design, visual design, and overall product quality.

  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers to define problems, explore possibilities, and make thoughtful tradeoffs.

  • Bring a strong design point of view to cross-functional conversations and advocate constructively for customers and design quality.

  • Use research, data, business context, and sound design judgment to guide decisions.

  • Help shape an evolving product area and contribute to the development of its broader UI patterns and systems.

  • Present work clearly and build alignment among partners with different perspectives and priorities.

  • Contribute to the team’s design culture through critique, collaboration, and mentorship.

  • Apply AI-enabled tools thoughtfully where they improve the design process, while keeping human judgment and customer needs at the center.

Why You're a Great Fit

  • Significant experience designing and shipping complex digital products, ideally within fintech, financial services, commerce, transportation, or another multi-stakeholder environment.

  • A portfolio demonstrating strong UX thinking alongside polished visual and UI execution.

  • Experience owning ambiguous product spaces and moving work forward without a fully defined path.

  • Strong interaction-design fundamentals and exceptional attention to detail.

  • The confidence to advocate for design while remaining open, collaborative, and pragmatic.

  • Experience working closely with product management and engineering throughout the development process.

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, including the ability to explain decisions and bring partners along.

  • Good judgment about when to challenge assumptions, when to seek additional context, and when to make a decision.

  • Practical familiarity with AI tools and an informed perspective on how they can support product-design work.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing consumer financial products, including cash management, banking, budgeting, payments, or financial-wellness tools.

  • Experience contributing to or evolving a design system.

  • Experience working within a product organization whose teams, processes, or product strategy were undergoing change.

What Success Looks Like

During your first few months, you’ll develop a deep understanding of our customers, products, and business; build trusted relationships with your design and cross-functional partners; and establish design as an integral part of the product-development process.

Over time, you’ll take clear ownership of your space, raise the quality of its customer experience, and help the team make better product decisions through a combination of craft, curiosity, and conviction.

Why Join Us

  • Own an important and evolving area of the product with meaningful customer impact.

  • Help define both the experience and visual direction of a complex financial ecosystem.

  • Join a team that values strong design judgment, constructive debate, and thoughtful collaboration.

  • Work directly with product-minded partners who care deeply about customers and shipping useful products.

  • Influence how design operates as the broader product organization continues to evolve.

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What you'll get at Tilt

  • Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

  • Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

  • Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

  • Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

  • Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

  • Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

Compensation Range: $164K - $205K

jobs.title: Sales Enablement Specialist - Partner and Sales Training
jobs.excerpt: At Fusion Connect, we’re not just offering jobs — we’re building careers that empower, inspire, and grow with you.
jobs.description:
At Fusion Connect, we’re not just offering jobs — we’re building careers that empower, inspire, and grow with you.

If you're passionate about making an impact, collaborating with forward-thinking teams, and being part of a company that values your voice, you’re in the right place.

We’re thrilled you’re exploring this opportunity with us — take a look, imagine the possibilities, and let’s shape the future of connectivity together.

Job Description Summary:

Fusion Connect is seeking a collaborative and highly organized Sales Enablement Specialist - Partner & Sales Training to support the development, onboarding, and ongoing enablement of our internal Sales and Customer Experience teams and external partner community. This role will have primary responsibility for administering and coordinating the partner onboarding experience, ensuring new partners have the knowledge, tools, resources, and training needed to effectively position and sell Fusion Connect solutions.

The Sales Enablement Specialist will also serve as a sales trainer and facilitator, delivering product, solution, sales skills, process, and go-to-market training across Fusion Connect's Sales and Customer Experience organizations and partner ecosystem. Working closely with Product, Product Marketing, Sales, CX, Channel, and other subject-matter experts, this individual will help identify training needs, translate complex product and business information into practical learning experiences, and develop or enhance training content and enablement resources.

The ideal candidate is an engaging facilitator, strong communicator, and organized program administrator who is comfortable learning technical concepts and translating them into clear, actionable content for sellers and customer-facing teams.

Job Description:

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following (other duties may be assigned):

Partner Onboarding & Enablement

  • Own the administration and coordination of the partner onboarding program, providing a consistent and effective onboarding experience for new Fusion Connect partners.
  • Coordinate onboarding activities, training schedules, required resources, system and portal education, and other enablement activities necessary to prepare partners to sell Fusion Connect solutions.
  • Serve as a primary enablement point of contact throughout the partner onboarding process, working closely with Channel Managers and other internal stakeholders.
  • Track partner onboarding progress, participation, completion, and readiness and identify opportunities to improve the onboarding experience.
  • Maintain partner onboarding materials, learning paths, checklists, job aids, and supporting resources.
  • Deliver ongoing partner education following initial onboarding, including product updates, new solution launches, sales skills, tools, processes, and go-to-market initiatives.
  • Gather feedback from partners and Channel Managers to continuously improve partner onboarding and enablement programs.

Sales & CX Training

  • Facilitate engaging instructor-led and virtual training for internal Sales, Customer Experience, and other customer-facing teams.
  • Deliver training across topics including product and solution knowledge, sales methodology and skills, competitive positioning, sales tools, processes, systems, and go-to-market initiatives.
  • Adapt training delivery based on audience needs, including new hires, experienced sellers, CX professionals, Channel Managers, and external partners.
  • Reinforce learning through follow-up sessions, coaching resources, job aids, knowledge checks, and other enablement activities.
  • Support internal new-hire sales onboarding and ongoing learning programs as needed.
  • Partner with Sales and CX leadership to identify skill gaps and determine where training or enablement can improve seller effectiveness and customer outcomes.

Product Training & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Establish a strong working partnership with the Product organization to understand upcoming product launches, enhancements, changes, and strategic priorities.
  • Work with Product and other subject-matter experts to identify the knowledge and skills Sales, CX, and Partners need to successfully position, sell, support, and discuss Fusion Connect solutions.
  • Translate product information and technical concepts into practical, seller-friendly training and enablement.
  • Coordinate and deliver training associated with new product launches, product updates, and changes to Fusion Connect's solution portfolio.
  • Help ensure training is delivered to the appropriate audiences at the appropriate point in the product launch and go-to-market process.
  • Gather feedback from Sales, CX, and Partners regarding product knowledge gaps and communicate those needs back to Product and Enablement leadership.

Training Content & Instructional Design

  • Develop and maintain training materials in partnership with subject-matter experts, including presentations, facilitator guides, participant materials, job aids, reference guides, knowledge checks, and e-learning content where appropriate.
  • Apply basic instructional design and adult-learning principles to make training practical, engaging, and relevant to the learner.
  • Convert complex product, process, and sales information into clear learning objectives and easy-to-understand training content.
  • Refresh existing training materials as products, processes, tools, and go-to-market strategies evolve.
  • Maintain an organized library of current training and enablement resources.
  • Support the development of scalable learning programs that combine instructor-led training, self-directed learning, reinforcement, and practical application.

Enablement Program Support

  • Collaborate with Sales, CX, Channel, Product, Marketing, Operations, and other teams to identify and prioritize enablement needs.
  • Support sales enablement initiatives including product launches, sales plays, competitive positioning, sales process changes, and other strategic programs.
  • Track training participation, completion, learner feedback, and other measures to help evaluate training effectiveness.
  • Recommend improvements to training programs based on learner feedback, business needs, and observed performance gaps.
  • Support administration of sales enablement and learning platforms as appropriate.
  • Take on additional training and enablement initiatives as business needs evolve.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Requirements:

  • Experience in sales enablement, sales training, partner/channel enablement, learning and development, or a related field.
  • Strong presentation and facilitation skills with the ability to engage both virtual and in-person audiences.
  • Ability to translate technical or complex information into clear, practical training for sales and customer-facing audiences.
  • Strong written communication and content-development skills.
  • Working knowledge of instructional design and adult-learning principles.
  • Ability to develop effective training materials including presentations, facilitator guides, job aids, reference materials, and knowledge checks.
  • Strong organizational and project-management skills with the ability to coordinate multiple onboarding and training initiatives simultaneously.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, CX, Channel, Marketing, and Operations teams.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and confidence working with both internal employees and external partners.
  • Ability to learn new products, technologies, processes, and systems quickly.
  • Experience administering onboarding, training, or learning programs strongly preferred.
  • Ability to work independently while effectively managing multiple priorities and deadlines.

Education and/or Experience Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or GED required; Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, Education, Instructional Design, Learning & Development, or a related discipline preferred.
  • Three (3) or more years of experience in sales enablement, sales training, partner enablement, learning and development, or a related customer-facing enablement role preferred.
  • Experience delivering instructor-led and virtual training strongly preferred.
  • Experience developing training or enablement content preferred.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, learning management systems, partner portals, content management systems, and/or sales enablement platforms preferred.
  • Telecommunications, technology, SaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, networking, or related industry experience is a plus.
