Job Description:

Web Developer – .NET, Blazor and Azure - C-SAM UK

C-SAM develops specialist asset management, rental, service, certification and operational software for customers operating across the UK and international markets.
We are currently investing heavily in the development of our next-generation web application framework. This framework will modernise our established Windows-based software and provide a scalable, secure and configurable cloud platform for both existing and new customers.
We are looking for a practical and experienced Web Developer to join our development team and help build, improve and deliver this new platform.

The Web Developer will work primarily on C-SAM’s newest web application framework, developing reusable components, customer-facing modules, integrations and core platform functionality.
You will work across the full development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment and ongoing improvement.
The role will also involve understanding and, where required, migrating functionality from our existing VB.NET, WinForms and SQL Server applications into the new web platform.
This is a hands-on development role suited to someone who enjoys solving real business problems, working with complex workflows and building software that is reliable, maintainable and easy for users to operate.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and maintain functionality within C-SAM’s new .NET web application framework.
• Build reusable Blazor components, shared services and configurable application modules.
• Develop responsive and user-friendly web interfaces.
• Convert existing Windows application functionality into modern web-based workflows.
• Work with product owners, operational teams and customers to understand business requirements.
• Design and implement secure, scalable and maintainable solutions.
• Develop and optimise Entity Framework queries and data access services.
• Create and maintain SQL Server stored procedures, views, functions and scripts.
• Improve application and database performance.
• Build integrations with customer systems, third-party APIs and cloud services.
• Assist with data migration, cleansing and validation activities.
• Develop authentication, role-based access and permission functionality.
• Support multi-company, multi-entity and multi-customer application structures.
• Write unit tests and assist with integration, regression and user acceptance testing.
• Diagnose and resolve software defects and performance issues.
• Review code and contribute to development standards and architecture decisions.
• Produce clear technical documentation and implementation notes.
• Support application deployments to Azure environments.
• Work with AI-assisted development tools, including OpenAI Codex, to improve development speed and quality.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of the framework, development processes and coding standards.

Essential Skills and Experience

• Strong commercial experience developing applications using C# and .NET.
• Experience developing web applications using Blazor Server, Blazor WebAssembly, ASP.NET Core or a similar Microsoft web technology.
• Strong SQL Server knowledge, including:
o T-SQL
o Stored procedures
o Views
o Joins and aggregations
o Query optimisation
o Indexing
o Execution plans
o Data migration scripts
• Experience using Entity Framework or Entity Framework Core.
• Good understanding of object-oriented programming and software design principles.
• Experience developing REST APIs and integrating with third-party services.
• Experience with dependency injection and service-based application architecture.
• Experience using Git and source control workflows.
• Good understanding of application security, authentication and role-based permissions.
• Ability to investigate and resolve complex technical and business problems.
• Ability to work with existing applications and understand established business logic.
• Strong attention to detail and a focus on producing reliable, supportable software.
• Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively within a small development team.

Desirable Skills and Experience

The following experience would be beneficial but is not essential:

• VB.NET development experience.

• WinForms or WPF application development.
• Experience modernising or migrating desktop applications to web technologies.
• Crystal Reports development and support.
• Experience converting Crystal Reports into web-based or alternative reporting solutions.
• Microsoft Azure experience, including:
o Azure App Service
o Azure SQL Database
o Azure Storage
o Azure Functions
o Application Insights
o Key Vault
o Azure DevOps
o Microsoft Entra ID
• Experience with Microsoft Authentication Library (MSAL), single sign-on or multi-factor authentication.
• Experience building multi-tenant or multi-company SaaS applications.
• Experience with MAUI or cross-platform application development.
• Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript and responsive web design.
• Experience with component libraries such as Ignite UI.
• Experience developing dashboards, charts and operational reporting.
• Knowledge of background processing, scheduled services and message queues.
• Experience with document generation, barcode printing, label printing or local printing services.
• Experience integrating accounting, shipping, CRM, ERP or asset management systems.
• Experience working with AI development tools such as OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot or Azure AI services.
• Knowledge of prompt design, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation or vector search.
• Familiarity with secure software development practices and standards such as ISO 27001.
• Experience working within rental, asset management, service, maintenance, logistics or certification-based industries.

Technical Environment

The successful candidate is likely to work with technologies including:

  • C#
  • VB.NET
  • .NET and ASP.NET Core
  • Blazor Server
  • Entity Framework Core
  • SQL Server
  • Azure SQL Database
  • REST APIs
  • HTML and CSS
  • JavaScript
  • Microsoft Azure
  • Microsoft Entra ID and MSAL
  • Git and Azure DevOps
  • Crystal Reports
  • WinForms and WPF
  • .NET MAUI
  • OpenAI Codex and Azure AI services

Personal Characteristics

  • Practical and solutions-focused, with a passion for delivering business value.

  • Commercially aware, with the ability to connect technical solutions to business needs.

  • Confident working within complex and established technology environments.

  • Accountable, proactive, and committed to seeing work through to completion.

  • Focused on quality, maintainability, performance, security, and reliability.

  • Open to change, continuous improvement, and innovation.

  • Strong communicator with the ability to engage a wide range of stakeholders.

  • Adaptable and effective in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

  • Committed to the responsible use of AI and modern technologies to improve outcomes and efficiency.

Qualifications and Experience

• A degree or equivalent qualification in software development, computer science or a related subject is desirable.
• Equivalent commercial experience will also be considered.
• Previous experience in a commercial software development role is required.
• Experience delivering business-critical software to external customers would be advantageous.

Working Arrangements

This role will involve working closely with C-SAM’s development, operations, professional services and management teams.
The position may be office-based, hybrid or remote depending on the successful candidate’s location and experience.
Occasional travel may be required for team meetings, customer workshops, implementation support or training.
Some flexibility may occasionally be required when supporting international customers operating in different time zones.

What We Offer

• The opportunity to help shape a new application framework and product platform.
• A varied role involving new development, architecture, integrations and modernisation.
• Exposure to international customers and complex operational software.
• The opportunity to work with modern Microsoft and AI technologies.
• A small-team environment where individual contributions have a visible impact.
• Opportunities to influence technical direction, development standards and future products.
• Ongoing professional development and training.

Measures of Success

Success in the role will include:

• Delivering reliable functionality within agreed timescales.
• Producing maintainable and reusable framework components.
• Reducing defects and support issues through good design and testing.
• Improving application and database performance.
• Supporting the successful migration of Windows functionality into the web platform.
• Contributing positively to development standards, documentation and team knowledge.
• Using AI-assisted development tools effectively while maintaining appropriate code quality, security and review controls.
• Helping deliver a secure, scalable and commercially successful web platform.

Job Title: Senior Platform Engineer - AI Platform

Location: United States

Workplace Type: Remote

Job Summary

The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we'd love for you to be a part of it as our Senior Platform Engineer - AI Platform.

ISN is hiring a Senior Platform Engineer to lead AI-first platform work at the intersection of agentic systems and production infrastructure. You'll design and ship the systems that let agents and LLMs do real work inside a high-volume product — spanning scheduling, report intake, customer communication, billing workflows, and data extraction. You'll also own the foundation underneath it: our PHP application, AWS/ECS infrastructure, and MySQL/Aurora data layer. This role offers unusual latitude to define how AI works at ISN, backed by the scale and stability of Porch Group and the data of a category-leading home inspection software platform.

What You Will Do As A Senior Platform Engineer - AI Platform

  • Build AI features end to end — retrieval, context engineering, structured output, tool/function calling, and evaluation harnesses that measure whether a change actually made things better
  • Design and operate agent orchestration systems — multi-agent and multi-step workflows including task decomposition, tool routing, state and memory, retries and fallbacks, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and guardrails against failure modes that don't look like exceptions
  • Operate non-deterministic systems responsibly — tracing, evals in CI, prompt and model versioning, token and latency budgets, model routing, and cost controls
  • Own ECS container platform operations — service definitions, task sizing, autoscaling, blue/green deploys, and orchestration for both long-running services and async workers
  • Architect AWS infrastructure — event-driven and serverless pipelines (Lambda, SQS/SNS/EventBridge), IAM and network design, all managed as infrastructure as code
  • Build and extend services in our production PHP codebase, integrating AI capability into existing product surfaces without destabilizing them
  • Drive database performance at scale — schema design, indexing, replication and read scaling, zero-downtime migrations, and query performance work across MySQL and Aurora
  • Raise the bar across the team through code review, design docs, mentorship, incident response, and on-call participation

What You Will Bring As A Senior Platform Engineer - AI Platform

  • 10+ years building and running production software, with real ownership of systems at scale
  • Demonstrated, hands-on experience shipping LLM-backed features — not just API calls, but agent orchestration, RAG, evaluation, and the operational discipline to keep them working
  • Strong PHP (8.x) skills in a mature, high-traffic codebase
  • Deep AWS architecture experience with hands-on ECS operations, infrastructure as code (Terraform or CDK), and CI/CD
  • Expert-level relational database skills with MySQL and/or Aurora — able to read an execution plan and act on it
  • Strong fundamentals in distributed systems, API design, observability, and application security
  • Clear written communication and sound judgment about tradeoffs, especially where AI is the wrong tool for the job
  • Nice to have: Go, MCP or comparable agent-tooling standards, vector search and embedding pipelines, Kubernetes, document and image extraction pipelines, or real estate/proptech/field-services domain experience

jobs.excerpt: We're transforming the grocery industryAt Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together.
jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Caper is at the forefront of Physical AI, building smart shopping carts that sense and respond to the real world in real time. By bringing intelligence onto the cart, Caper digitizes the entire in-store shopping journey, turning every trip into an interactive, personalized experience from the first item added to checkout. Our plug-and-play technology requires no store renovation or operational overhaul — retailers simply add Caper Carts and instantly upgrade their stores into connected, intelligent shopping environments. Caper is one of the fastest-growing retail automation technology products in the market and is already widely adopted across the industry.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own recommendations and personalization on the Caper Cart. In this role, you will define how the cart decides what to show each shopper, when to show it, and how it adapts to who they are. Every recommendation, moment of inspiration, and ranking decision on the cart screen runs through the systems you will build and refine.

This is a unique opportunity to sit at the intersection of recommendation systems, machine learning, and a physical shopping experience that unfolds in real time as a customer moves through a store. You will blend ML and data science work with hands-on UX design thinking, partnering closely with Instacart's discovery and personalization platforms while shaping a first-of-its-kind experience for the Caper customer. You will report to the Group Product Manager for Caper Customer Value and work alongside a tight-knit team of three product managers, with broad cross-functional reach across Engineering, Data Science, Design, Ads, and Operations.

About the Job

  • Set and own the vision for recommendations and personalization on Caper. Caper turns the store itself into a personalization surface, where every item added and every step through the store is a chance to show something useful in the moment. You will drive Engagement as a primary pillar metric — growing customer interactions, building monetizable surfaces, and diversifying the content mix to serve savings, discovery, and health-focused shoppers.
  • Own the system that decides what to show and when. Mature recommendation and item ranking using machine learning, including LLM-based techniques, and use real-time signals — cart location and motion, lists, search, and Instacart personalization data — to deliver content at the moments it is most relevant rather than constant or intrusive.
  • Drive AI-first innovation to expand what Caper shows shoppers. Ship net-new content types with nuanced product information and pairings tailored to each individual, and lead the architecture for capturing real-time, in-session signals that make personalization feel genuinely intelligent.
  • Champion a high-quality, intuitive shopping experience by partnering closely with Design to translate complex personalization logic into interactions that feel simple and natural on the cart screen. Spend time in labs and partner stores to observe real shopper behavior, test features, and iterate quickly based on what you learn.
  • Run a fast, experiment-driven roadmap and serve as the product lead for recommendations and personalization across the organization — aligning senior stakeholders on strategy, tradeoffs, and progress, and partnering cross-functionally with Engineering, Data Science, Design, Ads, and Operations from discovery through launch with clear PRDs and measurable success criteria.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of product management experience or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience partnering with ML or data science teams to ship models into a production consumer product
  • Experience defining and driving engagement or relevance metrics, and using experimentation to move them
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage data and quantitative analysis to make sound decisions in ambiguous environments
  • Track record of close partnership with UX design teams and applying strong design thinking practices throughout the product development process
  • Strong communication and influencing skills, with experience presenting to large groups and aligning multiple senior stakeholders on strategy and tradeoffs

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building recommendation, personalization, ranking, or search products
  • Experience with consumer-facing hardware, IoT, or physical retail products
  • Familiarity with retail, grocery, ads, or marketplace recommendation systems

jobs.description:
Senior Director I, AP Computer Science and CyberGeneralist, Curriculum and Assessment

College Board -AP

Location:This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have theoptionof being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employeesare required tooccasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type:This is a full-time position

About the Team

The AP Curriculum and Assessment Team at College Board (125+ staff) collaborates with colleagues across all aspects of the AP Program to develop, manage, and deliver AP’s 43 courses in a wide variety of subject areas. AP® is a rigorous academic program built on the commitment, passion, and hard work of students and educators from secondary schools and higher education. AP provides willing and academically prepared high school students with the opportunity to study and learn at the college level. AP’s course teams comprised of educators and disciplinary experts ensure that course curricula are aligned to higher education expectations and reflect the state of the art in the discipline, contribute to instructional resources and tools for teachers, and develop assessments that allow students in these courses to demonstrate their mastery of course content and skills. AP leads in strategic use of AI to expand student access, strengthen instructional design and professional support, and enhance assessment creation and exam analysis. The Math and Computer Science department, which includes computer science, precalculus, calculus, and statistics, is currently made up of 11 people supporting 6 courses in the AP portfolio. 

About the Opportunity

As the Senior Director I, AP Computer Science and Cyber Generalist,CurriculumAssessmentyou will be responsible for preserving and improving the quality and validity of the AP Program’s core deliverables within the subject domain: the exam, the course curriculum, and the professional development content. You are also responsible for item development and management from authoring to administration across multiple course titles; training and collaborating with subject-matter experts (SMEs), typically college professors and secondary school teachers. You will ethically and effectively integrate AI technologies in assessment creation and review, providing leadership and modeling for course experts across multiple course titles. This includes judiciously using AI assisted tools to support fairness, validity, and innovation in AP assessments. You will train SMEs on assessment development protocols, translate between academics and technical experts (psychometricians), and collaborate to develop formative assessment materials and resources to support AP Computer Science and Cyber teachers worldwide. You will serve as a point of contact in AP for committees and communities of subject-matter experts and will be responsible for the curriculum and assessment for AP Computer Science and Cyber, and, in partnership with other AP teams, further the strategic growth of AP Computer Science and Cyber across the globe. Additionally, you may have the opportunity to present, speak, and moderate dialogue with academic and membership audiences to ensure that ongoing change and improvement within AP courses and exams is understood, accepted, and supported in secondary and post-secondary educational communities.  

In this role, you will:

Assessment Development and Scoring (40-50%)  

  • Serve as an assessment leader for AP Computer Science and Cyber, with primary responsibility for assessment development and final assessment (items and forms) approval for AP Computer Science and CyberYour work will vary from year to year, with accountability across multiple test titles, requiring assessment and content domain expertise across multiple subject areas. You will be accountable for developing and reviewing content, and providing final program sign-off on test forms. You will be assigned work based upon needs that vary year to year, which means you will be accountable for seamlessly moving in and out of assessment workstreams across subjects, leveraging your expertise about assessment, assessment processes, and content domain expertise. Your work in developing and revising test content is of the quality that typically requires no adjustments based on feedback from your manager and other program leaders. 

  • Independently lead processes for authoring and revising assessment content, including training educator constituents. Leverage generative AI (as appropriate for subject/discipline) to author and/or review assessment content to improve and/or make more efficient assessment processes and outputs. 

  • Independently lead the development and management of assessment content (formative and summative) and scoring materials for AP Computer Science and Cyberthrough iterative review stages with multiple internal and external stakeholders, including the AP Computer Science and CyberTeam, Assessment Production team, Test Development Committee, and the Chief Reader, as appropriate. 

  • Independently lead the development of assessment forms for AP Computer Science and Cyber, ensuring the AP Exam development aligns with approved curricula and test specifications. 

  • Lead multiple face-to-face, weekend meetings, and virtual meetings (during work week, evenings, or weekends) annually with the AP Computer Science and CyberTest Development Committees. You independently strategize and develop an agenda and approach to ensure the committee’s meeting time is of the highest productivity; you successfully adapt and pivot during the meeting as needed; and you successfully resolve all post-meeting item content edits. 

  • Train and directly supervise Test Development Committee members in AP Computer Science and Cyberas content development contributors and reviewers.  

  • Lead the successful scoring of student responses for AP Computer Science and CyberExams at the annual scoring event in person and online—the “AP Reading”—and produce AP Reading publications materials for teacher and student use. You independently plan all-year, with increasing intensity in the months leading up to the Reading, ensuring all workflow steps for this incredibly complex event, as well as all post-Reading activities, are accounted for and successfully executed. 

Assessment Quality and Process (25-30%) 

  • Contribute to current research and best practices in assessment, and engage regularly with AP Curriculum & Assessment colleagues to align on standards and shared principles guiding AP’s assessment directions 

  • Provide functional leadership of cross-subject assessment workstreams to ensure consistency and leverage efficiencies. Will serve as an expert resource for course team and leadership consultation.  

  • Provide formal training and informal mentoring to other Course Experts within your AP Computer Science and Cyber team, based on need. 

  • Develop strong efficiencies in item development through well-defined and well-documented task models, item development training and processes, and highly effective use of generative AI.  

  • Independently lead (with limited managerial support) initiatives to refine and improve question task models as well as exam design in collaboration with AP Curriculum & Assessment leaders and aligned to other College Board initiatives including AI innovation and professional learning best practices that scale assessment to achieve psychometric and disciplinary best practices on AP Computer Science and Cyberexams. 

  • Monitor exam validity, security, reliability, fairness, and quality, as well as reader reliability in accordance with established Program thresholds for AP Computer Science and Cyberexams. Identify areas for improvement and independently (with limited managerial support) lead and execute targeted initiatives to improve. 

  • Collaborate with psychometrics and AP Curriculum & Assessment staff to establish fair, reliable, and valid cut scores for AP Computer Science and Cyberexams. 

Staff Development and Capacity Building (25-30%) 

  • Train and support course experts in assessment development practices, including quality, validity, fairness, and use of generative AI, deepening their understanding of the item and test development lifecycle, and effective use of item authoring and item bank platforms. 

  • Mentor team members in effectively facilitating test development committees and working with external stakeholders.  

Course Development and Program Support (0-10%) 

  • Refine and improve AP Computer Science and CyberCourse Frameworks to ensure clear and explicit learning outcomes that align with strategic priorities, including ensuring college/disciplinary standards as well as expanding the scope of reaching a broader audience of AP students.  

  • Collaborate with AP teams to support the development of new products for AP Computer Science and Cyberdesigned to address unmet teacher instructional needs, potentially including developing prototypes, participating in small-scale market-testing, and creating models for subsequent development in conjunction with other AP workstreams.  

About You

 To qualify for this role, you must have:

  • A Master’s degree in computer science, cybersecurity, or networking or a directly related discipline, and knowledge of current trends in the discipline (required), although a doctorate in the discipline is strongly preferred  

  • Fluency in Java

  • Expertise in computer science, cybersecurity, or networking with at least 10 years of experience in standardized assessment development or related work; experience with digital assessment and teaching preferred 

  • Strong oral and written communication skills, with solid technical proficiency and a customer-focused mindset 

  • Excellent organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and maintain close attention to detail, including proofreading 

  • Demonstrated ability to implement processes and procedures, manage project plans and schedules, and maintain tracking documentation 

  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across all levels, and engage in giving and receiving constructive feedback 

  • Ability to travel 6-8 times per year, plus up to two additional weeks for the AP Reading; must be eligible to work in the United States 

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work

  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.

  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal

  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receivingtimely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.

  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.

  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success

  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled.This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.

  • Whilethehiring processmay vary, it generallyincludes:resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

AtCollegeBoard, we offer more than a paycheck: we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive.We’rea self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $112,000 - $170,000.

  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.

  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.

  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’llhave open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and whatit’slike to work atCollegeBoard throughout your hiring process. Check outourcareers pageformore.

Well versed in insurance and investment strategies, this team is adept in constructing lending solutions that are easy to understand, suited to a client’s individual needs and align with the advisor’s strategies for their clients.

jobs.excerpt: Welcome to the intersection of energy and home services.
jobs.description:
Welcome to the intersection of energy and home services. At NRG, we’re driven by our passion to create a smarter, cleaner and more connected future.

Vivint Smart Home, an NRG owned company, is a leading smart home company in the United States, dedicated to redefining the home experience with intelligent products and services. We find purpose in proactively protecting and keeping our customers connected to home, no matter where they are. Join the Smart Home team to create smarter, safer and more sustainable homes.

Position Summary: Director of Product Mgmt – Partner Experiences

The Director of Product Management for Partner Ecosystem & Integrations is the single-threaded owner responsible for the strategy, technical roadmap, and end-to-end integration of third-party (3P) partner devices into the Vivint Home ecosystem. Operating as a high-impact, independent strategic leader, you will expand the boundary of the smart home by enabling external hardware—such as smart lighting, advanced climate controls, multi-vendor sensors, and entertainment platforms—to work seamlessly alongside Vivint’s proprietary hardware suite.

This is an individual contributor role requiring a highly technical product leader who can operate autonomously without a direct team of direct reports. You will specialize in developing deep technical relationships with engineering and product teams at world-class technology companies, leveraging their specialized expertise to accelerate Vivint’s ecosystem growth. You will bridge the gap between external APIs/protocols and internal architecture to deliver zero-friction, deeply integrated consumer experiences at scale.

Primary Responsibilities

Strategic Ecosystem & Integration Roadmap

  • 3P Partner Roadmap Ownership: Own the multi-year product strategy, prioritization, and technical execution blueprint for all third-party device integrations within the Vivint Home ecosystem.
  • Strategic Partner Evaluation: Serve as the organization’s primary scout and thought leader on identifying external technical partners whose hardware expertise can fill critical portfolio gaps and unlock "new-to-world" smart home experiences.
  • Seamless Interoperability Standards: Define the strict performance, security, and user experience baselines that external hardware partners must meet to ensure flawless, native performance inside the Vivint app ecosystem.

Technical Execution & Architecture Alignment

  • Cross-Organizational Architecture: Partner with internal Core Platform Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, and Information Security teams to design scalable, secure SDKs and APIs that facilitate low-latency 3P device communication.
  • Standards Advocacy: Drive Vivint’s product alignment with emerging smart home industry standards (such as Matter, Thread, and specialized cloud-to-cloud APIs) to simplify external onboarding and future-proof the ecosystem.
  • Technical Authoring: Independently write data-driven strategy narratives, business requirements documents (BRDs), and product definitions (PRFAQs) to gain executive alignment on high-stakes ecosystem expansion opportunities.

Influence, Negotiation & Partnership Development

  • External Technical Diplomacy: Act as the primary technical product interface to external partners' product and engineering organizations, steering their roadmaps to align with Vivint’s architectural needs. Including negotiating and owning the partner relationships.
  • Matrixed Internal Influence: Operate with extreme autonomy to influence, unblock, and drive execution across internal cross-functional peer organizations, including Software, Legal, UX Design, and QA Engineering teams.
  • Lifecycle Governance: Build rigorous integration testing and post-launch telemetry review mechanisms to continuously evaluate the performance, stability, and customer satisfaction of third-party hardware integrations.

Required Skills & Functional Dimensions

  • Autonomous Individual Contribution: Proven track record of operating with complete strategic independence. You must excel at leading via cross-functional influence without relying on administrative reporting lines.
  • Integration & API Literacy: Deep technical understanding of cloud-to-cloud integrations, local wireless mesh topologies (Zigbee, Z-Wave, Thread), device driver layers, and platform-level SDK development.
  • Ecosystem Design Thinker: Exceptional systems-thinking capability with a focus on creating frictionless user experiences when combining hardware and software assets from completely distinct corporate entities.
  • Executive Presence & Narrative Construction: Superb written and verbal communication skills. Proven ability to command technical discussions with external executives and synthesize complex partnership logistics into clear execution milestones for internal leadership.

Required Education & Experience

  • Experience: 8+ years of product management experience, with at least 4+ years explicitly focused on building developer platforms, partner API ecosystems, IoT integrations, or connected smart home environments.
  • Partnership Track Record: Demonstrated experience leading complex, technical product integrations with tier-1 consumer electronics or software enterprise partners.

We’re looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role.

You won’t be writing production code.

You’ll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What This Role Actually Is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios — focusing on:

  • Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful

  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment

  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste — not syntax correctness.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end-to-end

  • Judge whether outputs are:

    • Useful

    • Correct (at a high level)

    • Aligned with how a strong engineer would think

  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just code

  • Distinguish between different levels of response quality (e.g. what makes something a 2 vs 4)

  • Provide clear, opinionated feedback on:

    • What worked

    • What didn’t

    • What felt “off” or misleading

  • Help define what great looks like when interacting with tools like Cursor

What We Mean by “Taste”

We’re specifically looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?

  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?

  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?

  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments.

Who You Are

    • Python

  • Able to evaluate code without needing to fully execute or deeply review every line

Tilt's Strategic Finance (StratFin) team is hiring a Senior Finance Lead dedicated to the Credit Card business unit. You'll be the embedded finance lead for Credit Card, owning the P&L, driving forecasting and unit economics, and acting as the primary financial thought partner to Credit Card product, credit/risk, and marketing leadership. Given the seniority of the role, you'll be expected to operate with significant autonomy and to shape strategic direction for the business, not just execute against it.

  • Own the Credit Card P&L: Drive the monthly forecast-vs-actual process, variance analysis, and financial reporting for the Credit Card business, including inputs to company-wide board and executive materials.

  • Be the embedded finance partner: Serve as the primary point of contact between Finance and Credit Card leadership — attending BU staff meetings, flagging financial risk/opportunity in real time, and translating operating decisions into financial impact.

  • Own unit economics: Build and maintain the Credit Card unit economics model (CAC, LTV, contribution margin, portfolio yield, delinquency and loss curves) and use it to evaluate new product, pricing, and credit line initiatives.

  • Partner with Credit/Data Science on portfolio performance: Translate model and portfolio performance (delinquency, roll rates, approval/pricing strategy) into financial terms for leadership.

  • Shape strategic priorities: Independently identify risks and opportunities in the Credit Card business and proactively bring recommendations to leadership, rather than waiting to be asked.

  • Drive AI-enabled finance workflows: Identify and implement opportunities to use AI tools (e.g., Claude, internal automation via Aleph/Databricks) to accelerate reporting, variance analysis, and ad hoc modeling — reducing manual cycle time and freeing capacity for higher-value strategic work.   • Demonstrated track record of owning a P&L or business unit's financial narrative at a senior level, including direct engagement with BU and executive leadership

jobs.description:
Senior AI Interaction Evaluator (Codex / Claude Code)

Contract | $100–$200/hour | 10–20 hrs/week | Start ASAP (through early May)

Check out this Loom video for more details!

We’re looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role.

You won’t be writing production code.

You’ll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What This Role Actually Is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios — focusing on:

  • Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful

  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment

  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste — not syntax correctness.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end-to-end

  • Judge whether outputs are:

    • Useful

    • Correct (at a high level)

    • Aligned with how a strong engineer would think

  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just code

  • Distinguish between different levels of response quality (e.g. what makes something a 2 vs 4)

  • Provide clear, opinionated feedback on:

    • What worked

    • What didn’t

    • What felt “off” or misleading

  • Help define what great looks like when interacting with tools like Cursor

What We Mean by “Taste”

We’re specifically looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?

  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?

  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?

  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments.

Who You Are

  • Staff / Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)

  • Strong background in one of the below:

    • TypeScript / JavaScript

    • Python

  • Hands-on experience using:

    • OpenAI Codex

    • Claude Code

    • Cursor

  • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows

  • Able to evaluate code without needing to fully execute or deeply review every line

  • Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback

  • High bar for what “good engineering” looks like

Nice to Have

  • Experience with tools like Cursor or similar AI-first IDEs

  • Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement Details

  • Rate: $100–$200/hour

  • Hours: ~10–20 hours/week

  • Duration: Through early May (with possible extension)

  • Start: ASAP

  • Process:

    • Take-home evaluation exercise

    • One behavioral interview

jobs.description:
Job Description:

DataRobot delivers AI that maximizes impact and minimizes business risk. Our platform and applications integrate into core business processes so teams can develop, deliver, and govern AI at scale. DataRobot empowers practitioners to deliver predictive and generative AI, and enables leaders to secure their AI assets. Organizations worldwide rely on DataRobot for AI that makes sense for their business — today and in the future.

We run agents and models in production for enterprises that cannot move their workloads to a public cloud: regulated industries, sovereign deployments, air-gapped and customer-managed clusters.

The control plane is the layer that makes that possible. It deploys the agents, it deploys the models those agents call, and it decides how every workload is placed, scaled, isolated, routed to, and torn down across Kubernetes clusters and heterogeneous accelerators, on our cloud and on the customer's.

Agents and models are one deployment problem here. An agent is a long-lived workload with session state and unpredictable fan-out, calling models with wildly uneven cost profiles, and both land on the same finite pool of accelerators. Allocating that pool correctly is the job.

You will own this layer as a product. You will spend your time in design reviews, in the API contract, and in production data.

What you will own

  • The deployment and workload API. Resource model, lifecycle semantics, versioning, backward compatibility, and the error behavior customers integrate against.

  • Placement and capacity. How workloads land on nodes and accelerators, how quota and priority work across tenants, and what happens under contention.

  • Scaling. Autoscaling signals, cold start and scale-to-zero economics, headroom policy, and the cost-versus-latency trade-off as a customer-facing control.

  • Agent runtime. Where an agent runs and for how long, how it is isolated, how its tool calls execute, and how its state survives a restart or an eviction.

  • Traffic and connectivity. Ingress and routing for model and agent endpoints, request-aware load balancing, tenancy boundaries, and private connectivity into customer networks.

  • Governance and audit. Who deployed what, who invoked it, under which policy and access control, and whether that record survives a customer audit.

  • Metering and packaging. How inference is measured, quota'd, attributed to a tenant, and priced.

  • Reliability. The SLOs, the error budget, and the operational surface a platform engineer uses to diagnose a degraded deployment without opening a ticket with us.

You will hold the roadmap for this layer across two engineering pods and align with the product teams building on top of it.

What we are looking for

  • 6+ years in product management for infrastructure, developer platforms, or cloud services, at least 3 of them on Kubernetes-based or distributed systems products. Principal candidates bring 9+ years and a platform layer that other product teams built on.

  • Deep technical understanding of GPU and accelerator behavior: topology-aware placement, fractional and time-sliced sharing, MIG, device plugins and the driver and container runtime plumbing underneath them, memory as the binding constraint, and what utilization costs when a tenant holds a GPU it is not saturating.

  • Deep technical understanding of Kubernetes: the API server and scheduler, controllers and CRDs, operators, admission and RBAC, device plugins, resource requests and limits, node pools, and what happens when a pod cannot be scheduled.

  • Multi-tenancy experience: isolation models, noisy neighbors, quota and fairness, and tenancy designs that survive a customer security review.

  • API product judgment. You have owned a public or platform API and lived with the consequences of a contract you shipped.

  • Technical writing and prototyping as your default way to make a case: a doc an engineer will read, a deep dive, a public post, an API reference, or a working prototype.

  • Comfort operating with matrixed engineering teams and no direct reports.

  • BS or MS in Computer Science or a closely related technical field, or equivalent hands-on experience as a software, platform, or infrastructure engineer.

Nice to have:

  • Service networking depth: ingress and routing, load balancing under uneven request cost, DNS, TLS termination, private link connectivity, and network policy as a tenancy boundary.

  • Modern serving stacks and their failure modes: vLLM or similar, KV cache behavior, batching, quantization trade-offs.

  • Long-running and agentic workload patterns: session affinity, statefulness, tool-call fan-out, sandboxed execution.

  • Customer-managed, air-gapped, or sovereign deployments and the compliance constraints that come with them.

  • Regulated-industry experience where access control, secrets, and invocation-level auditability are product requirements.

  • CNCF or open-source contribution.

How we work with AI

We use AI tooling in the loop daily and expect the same here. The strongest candidates build to think: a prototype that exercises an API before it is specified, an evaluation harness, an agent wired against real services, a throwaway tool that answers a roadmap question in an afternoon. Bring one or two things you built yourself. Production-grade code is not the bar; getting to a first version without waiting on an engineer is.

Scope of the role

This role owns workload and agent runtime orchestration: placement, lifecycle, scaling, and isolation of agent and model workloads on Kubernetes and accelerators.

It does not own agent coordination and authoring (planner and router logic, memory strategy, multi-agent handoff, builder surfaces), workflow orchestration in the Airflow or Temporal sense, model quality and applied research, or cluster fabric work such as InfiniBand and RoCE tuning for distributed training.

There are no direct reports today. Scope here is technical surface area and influence across engineering pods.

The talent and dedication of our employees are at the core of DataRobot’s journey to be an iconic company. We strive to attract and retain the best talent by providing competitive pay and benefits with our employees’ well-being at the core. Here’s what your benefits package may include depending on your location and local legal requirements: Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance, Flexible Time Off Program, Paid Holidays, Paid Parental Leave, Global Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and more!

jobs.title: Sell-Side Transaction Manager - manda
jobs.excerpt: The companySmall businesses move fast.  Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight.
jobs.description:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

We're looking for a Sell-Side Transaction Manager to join the manda Deal Team! You will work with small business owners to help them successfully sell their businesses, across the entire M&A process.

manda is where AI meets Mergers & Acquisitions, iwoca's new M&A platform. Over the last months we have built an unbeatable proposition for the UK market of buying and selling small businesses. As a result, our pipeline has been growing rapidly, and we’re now looking to expand.

It is still difficult for business owners to sell their business or buy others in the sub-£10m EV market. Information asymmetry, lack of knowledge and low transaction amounts make it challenging. Many M&A companies shy away from serving this segment as they find it hard to do so profitably.

Iwoca has a deep footprint into the SME economy, with 150,000+ business as customers in the UK alone. We enabled this success by iwoca’s ability to build clean, efficient, and automated processes, which manda will now leverage to build the only M&A platform in the UK.

Your mission is to build and close a portfolio of seller mandates, sourced from three channels we already run: inbound from iwoca's 150,000+ SME customers, automated outbound to vendors matching live buyer mandates, and referrals from the searchers and acquirers in our buy-side pipeline. You won't be cold-calling from a list, but you will rigorously qualify a managed flow of warm leads. Your job includes challenges like establishing price realism and evaluating company sellability. Ultimately deciding which mandates are worth progressing and converting into completed transactions.

The team

You'll join the founding team building manda as a high-growth venture inside iwoca, with the autonomy and pace of a startup and the data, infrastructure, and credibility of a lender with 150,000+ SME customers behind you.

Day-to-day you'll work alongside our first sell-side Transaction Manager, splitting the seller portfolio and trading playbooks as we figure out what works. You'll partner closely with our buy-side Transaction Manager, who runs a live pipeline of qualified searchers and acquirers, that's your buyer pool, not a cold market. You'll also work directly with the Venture Lead on positioning, pricing, and the bigger calls on how the platform evolves.

The role

You'll own the sell-side journey of your portfolio end-to-end, from intake through completion. What makes this different from a traditional brokerage seat: you're not hunting for buyers on the open market. manda runs a live buy-side pipeline of qualified searchers and acquirers, and we're piloting acquisition finance through iwoca, so the buyers you bring to your sellers are pre-qualified and often pre-financed. Your edge is a structured process, a captive buyer pool, and the ability to put financing on the table. Your job is to convert that edge into closed transactions.

The requirements

  • 3+ years of SME M&A experience from a broker, advisory firm, or deal platform, with evidence of end-to-end deal execution under time pressure.

  • Ability to manage sellers with strongly varying M&A experience and impose price realism while maintaining trust and rapport.

  • Treat your portfolio like a P&L, you know which deals are moving, which are stalling, which to cut, and you make those calls without being asked.

  • Comfort with rapidly evolving processes and new tooling (including AI), with a high-output mindset and consistent delivery of iwoca-grade customer experience.

  • Fluency in UK SME deal structures, Share Purchase Agreement (SPA) terms, and payment mechanisms including earnouts and deferred consideration.

  • Comfortable interfacing with legal counsel, financial buyers, and accounting firms, coordinating between multiple parties through diligence and documentation.

  • Strong commercial instinct when working through incomplete information and maintaining deal velocity across a portfolio.

  • Comfortable being on the phone for hours a day, building trust quickly with business owners and reading emotional signals over the line.

Bonus, but not required:-

  • Experience working with imperfect financial data and owner-managed businesses in the £500k-£10m enterprise value range.

  • Understanding of financial due diligence outputs and how to translate technical findings into actionable seller guidance.

The salary

We expect to pay a base range of £40,000 to £90,000 (OTE: £90K – £240K) for this role, depending on experience and location.

Compensation includes a performance-linked incentive based on a fixed percentage of the transaction fees you generate. With this structure, performers typically earn total compensation between 1.5× and 2.5× base.

We're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Useful links:

Compensation Range: £40K - £90K

jobs.title: Storyous Partnerships & Integrations Manager
jobs.excerpt: O roliStoryous pomáhá lokálním podnikům řídit jejich každodenní provoz.
jobs.description:
O roli

Storyous pomáhá lokálním podnikům řídit jejich každodenní provoz. K tomu potřebujeme rozvíjet kvalitní spolupráci s technologickými, obchodními a oborovými partnery a zároveň zajistit, aby naše integrace přinášely skutečnou hodnotu zákazníkům i společnosti.

Hledáme člověka, který převezme plnou odpovědnost za dvě propojené oblasti:

  • Integrations: řízení a rozvoj integračního portfolia, spolupráce s technologickými partnery a vedení nových integračních iniciativ od nápadu až po stabilní provoz.

  • Partnerships: vyhledávání, vyjednávání a rozvoj partnerství, která pomohou Storyous oslovit více relevantních zákazníků a rozšířit hodnotu našeho produktu.

Nejde o roli, ve které člověk pouze předává požadavky dál. Budeš vlastníkem výsledku: pochopíš obchodní příležitost, vyhodnotíš její potenciál, navrhneš model spolupráce, vyjednáš podmínky, zajistíš realizaci, prosadíš potřebné změny napříč firmou a následně změříš, zda iniciativa přináší očekávanou hodnotu.

Tvoje mise

Vybudovat a řídit portfolio integrací a partnerství, které:

  • zvyšuje hodnotu Storyous pro zákazníky;

  • podporuje růst obchodních výsledků a akvizici nových zákazníků;

  • vytváří nové distribuční a obchodní příležitosti;

  • zlepšuje produktovou nabídku a uživatelskou zkušenost;

  • má jasný účel, odpovědnost, měřitelné cíle a udržitelný provozní model.

Co budeš dělat

1. Vlastnictví integračního portfolia

  • Převezmeš ownership nad stávajícími i novými integracemi Storyous.

  • Zmapuješ jejich obchodní účel, technický a provozní stav, zapojené týmy, náklady, přínosy a největší rizika.

  • Nastavíš jasný lifecycle integrace od prvotního posouzení přes realizaci a uvedení do provozu až po dlouhodobé vyhodnocování.

  • Budeš hlavním kontaktem pro klíčové technologické partnery.

  • Zajistíš, aby integrace nebyly pouze technicky funkční, ale také srozumitelné, obchodně uchopitelné a dlouhodobě udržitelné.

  • Společně s Product, Engineering a Operations budeš hledat možnosti standardizace, automatizace a zjednodušení podpory.

2. Vyhledávání a rozvoj partnerství

  • Vytvoříš partnerskou strategii v souladu s prioritami Storyous.

  • Budeš aktivně vyhledávat nové příležitosti mezi relevantními firmami, odborníky, distribučními kanály a dalšími subjekty s vazbou na cílový segment.

  • Zmapuješ, kde má partner obchodní motivaci Storyous doporučovat, prodávat, integrovat nebo společně nabízet zákazníkům.

  • Povedeš celý proces od identifikace a kvalifikace partnera přes návrh spolupráce a vyjednávání až po onboarding, launch a další rozvoj.

  • Navrhneš vhodný model spolupráce podle konkrétní příležitosti — například referral, reseller, co-selling, společná nabídka nebo strategická spolupráce.

  • Budeš hledat způsoby, jak partnerské vztahy převést do konkrétního obchodního dopadu, nikoliv pouze do počtu podepsaných smluv.

3. Business case, ekonomika a vyjednávání

  • Pro významné iniciativy připravíš business case založený na dostupných datech a realistických předpokladech.

  • Posoudíš potenciální obchodní přínos, náklady, kapacitu interních týmů, provozní náročnost a hlavní rizika.

  • Budeš navrhovat obchodní podmínky a ekonomický model integrací a partnerství ve spolupráci s relevantními týmy.

  • Povedeš jednání o obchodním modelu, odpovědnostech, podpoře, datových a provozních podmínkách i dalších klíčových tématech.

  • Budeš připravovat rozhodovací materiály pro leadership a umět doporučit, zda iniciativu realizovat, upravit, pilotovat nebo odložit.

4. Product a Engineering enablement

  • Přeložíš obchodní potřebu do jasného produktového a technického zadání.

  • Budeš rozumět principům integrací a produktového vývoje natolik, abys dokázal/a vést kvalifikovanou diskusi s interními i externími technickými stakeholdery.

  • Zajistíš, že požadavky mají jasný účel, rozsah, očekávaný přínos, prioritu a vlastníka.

  • Pokud bude pro realizaci potřeba kapacita Product nebo Engineering, převezmeš odpovědnost za prosazení priority a sladění stakeholderů.

  • Budeš hlídat, aby nové iniciativy měly odpovídající míru standardizace, opakovatelnosti a dlouhodobé udržitelnosti.

  • Zajistíš připravenost onboardingu, dokumentace, podpory, měření výsledků a provozní odpovědnosti před uvedením do provozu.

5. Go-to-market a adoption

  • Ve spolupráci se Sales, Marketingem, Customer Care a Product vytvoříš plán uvedení relevantních integrací a partnerství.

  • Připravíš value proposition, obchodní argumentaci, kvalifikační kritéria a podklady pro interní týmy i partnery.

  • Zajistíš, aby partner rozuměl nabídce Storyous, cílovým zákazníkům a způsobu předávání příležitostí.

  • Budeš sledovat nejen počet aktivovaných partnerů, ale především skutečné využívání a obchodní dopad.

  • Identifikuješ překážky v onboardingovém procesu a budeš je odstraňovat ve spolupráci s interními týmy i partnery.

6. Reporting, governance a kontinuální zlepšování

  • Nastavíš pravidelný reporting portfolia integrací a partnerství pro management.

  • Budeš sledovat vývoj pipeline, obchodní výsledky, aktivaci, využívání, náklady, přínosy a kvalitu provozu.

  • Zavedeš pravidelné business reviews s klíčovými partnery.

  • Budeš udržovat přehlednou evidenci smluv, vlastníků, obchodních podmínek, provozního stavu a dalších klíčových informací.

  • Budeš průběžně vyhodnocovat, které integrace a partnerství rozvíjet, standardizovat, renegociovat nebo ukončit.

Rozhodovací pravomoc a odpovědnost

Od této role očekáváme skutečný ownership, nikoliv pouze koordinaci. Budeš mít odpovědnost za to, aby:

  • každá prioritní iniciativa měla jasný cíl, business case, rozsah a měřítko úspěchu;

  • partnerství byla ekonomicky smysluplná a měla jasně definované odpovědnosti;

  • technické a produktové požadavky byly srozumitelné a měly odpovídající prioritu;

  • interní stakeholderové byli včas informováni a rozhodnutí se dotahovala;

  • problémy byly řešeny přímo a včas, včetně eskalace na správnou úroveň;

  • výsledek byl po uvedení do provozu měřen a případně korigován.

Budeš fungovat jako seniorní individual contributor: bez nutnosti velkého týmu pod sebou, ale s dostatečným vlivem a autoritou pro řízení komplexních iniciativ napříč Commercial, Product, Engineering, Operations, Customer Care, Finance a Legal.

Jak poznáme úspěch

Po 6–12 měsících budeš mít:

  • transparentní přehled integračního portfolia a jasný plán jeho rozvoje;

  • prioritizovaný pipeline nových integrací a partnerství s kvalitními business casy;

  • nové partnerské příležitosti, které generují relevantní obchodní výsledky;

  • zavedený proces od prvotního posouzení po uvedení do provozu a následné měření výsledků;

  • funkční reporting výkonu partnerství a integrací;

  • méně ad-hoc eskalací díky jasným vlastníkům, dokumentaci a provozním procesům;

  • prokazatelný dopad na akvizici zákazníků, revenue, retenci nebo produktovou hodnotu.

Konkrétní cíle a KPI nastavíme podle priorit Storyous v daném období. Mohou zahrnovat zejména:

  • kvalitu a vývoj partnerské pipeline;

  • počet a kvalitu leadů z partnerského kanálu;

  • obchodní výsledky a návratnost vybraných iniciativ;

  • aktivaci a využívání integrací;

  • rychlost uvedení prioritních iniciativ do provozu;

  • kvalitu provozu, podporu a spokojenost zákazníků i partnerů.

Co potřebuješ

Zkušenosti a odborné znalosti

  • Několik let zkušeností v business developmentu, partnerships, B2B sales, product partnerships, platform businessu nebo podobné komplexní roli.

  • Prokazatelnou zkušenost s vedením partnerství od prvního kontaktu až po dlouhodobý provoz.

  • Zkušenost s vyjednáváním obchodních podmínek a schopnost připravit i obhájit business case.

  • Praktickou zkušenost s projektovým řízením a koordinací více týmů bez přímé řídicí pravomoci.

  • Schopnost pracovat s daty, tabulkami a finančními modely.

  • Základní technické porozumění integracím a produktovému vývoji. Nemusíš být developer/ka, ale musíš umět technické téma pochopit, rozebrat a dotáhnout.

  • Zkušenost z fintechu, SaaS, payments, hospitality, retailu nebo podobného prostředí je výhodou.

Osobnost a způsob práce

  • Jsi samostatný/á, iniciativní a umíš si vytvořit vlastní plán práce.

  • Přemýšlíš obchodně, ale rozhoduješ se na základě dat a návratnosti.

  • Umíš být důsledný/á a dostatečně „pushy“, když projekt potřebuje posunout.

  • Dokážeš vést jednání s externím partnerem i interně prosadit potřebné rozhodnutí.

  • Umíš pracovat s nejasností, rozdělit komplexní problém na konkrétní kroky a dotahovat věci do konce.

  • Komunikuješ jasně, věcně a přizpůsobíš styl různým stakeholderům.

  • Nečekáš, až ti někdo předá hotový proces — umíš ho navrhnout, zavést a průběžně zlepšovat.

Jazyky

  • Plynulá čeština nebo slovenština.

  • Dobrá pracovní angličtina pro jednání s partnery a spolupráci v rámci Teya.

Co nabízíme

  • Seniorní roli s reálným vlivem na produkt, obchodní výsledky a další směr Storyous.

  • Možnost vlastnit agendu od strategie a business case až po realizaci a měřitelný výsledek.

  • Spolupráci s Commercial, Product, Engineering a Operations týmy v Česku i v rámci Teya.

  • Hybridní režim práce a flexibilitu.

  • Férovou fixní mzdu a motivující bonusovou složku.

  • 26 dní dovolené a 3 sick days.

  • Interní integrovaný Glean AI k vyhledávání informací v rámci celé společnosti s využitím nejmodernějších LLM

  • Přístup k Elredo audioknihovně

  • BenefitPlus kartu

  • Pravidelné týmové setkání v Praze a prostředí, kde se očekává iniciativa, otevřenost a odpovědnost.

Proč právě Storyous a Teya?

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Job Title: Global Creative Capability, AI & Innovation Lead

  • Location: Morristown, NJ

About the Job

The AI-Driven Customer Engagement (AICE) team is transforming how Sanofi goes to market by combining human expertise with AI, automation, data, and new ways of working.

The Marketing Transformation & AI Strategy team helps define and build the capabilities required to make this transformation real. This includes identifying and testing emerging technologies, redesigning workflows, developing scalable frameworks, and helping teams adopt new approaches across brands and markets.

As content creation becomes increasingly AI-enabled, visual design must evolve beyond traditional production. Designers need new tools, skills, standards, and operating models that allow them to work more efficiently while continuing to deliver high-quality, differentiated customer experiences.

This role will help shape that evolution—connecting visual design expertise with AI, creative technology, capability building, and organizational change.

The Global Creative Capability, AI & Innovation Lead is responsible for evolving how visual design is enabled and delivered across AICE and the broader marketing organization.

This is a transformation and capability-building role rather than a traditional content-production position. The role will evaluate and advance AI-enabled design tools, improve creative workflows, establish scalable design frameworks, and help visual designers adopt new technologies and ways of working.

A central responsibility will be coaching and developing visual designers across internal teams, distributed pods, and external partners. The role will create practical guidance, learning resources, templates, and communities of practice that enable designers to use emerging technologies effectively while maintaining strong standards for brand consistency, customer experience, accessibility, and quality.

The role will also serve as a subject-matter expert and strategic partner for teams exploring new visual design capabilities. This includes identifying business needs, translating them into capability requirements, testing potential solutions, and helping determine which tools and approaches should be piloted, scaled, integrated, or discontinued.

While the role may occasionally provide hands-on design support to test a new capability, create a proof of concept, or demonstrate a recommended approach, its primary purpose is to enable and elevate the work of others—not to serve as a central production resource.

Success requires deep visual design expertise, curiosity about emerging technology, and the ability to turn experimentation into practical, scalable ways of working. The ideal candidate combines the judgment of an experienced designer with the mindset of a coach, capability builder, and transformation leader.

Join the team transforming how healthcare is delivered for chronic and specialty conditions worldwide. In General Medicines, you’ll help drive meaningful outcomes in diabetes, transplant, and immunology with the scale and urgency patients deserve.

About Sanofi:

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives

Main Responsibilities

Visual Design Capability Strategy

  • Define and evolve the visual design capabilities needed to support Sanofi’s future marketing model.

  • Translate business, customer, and designer needs into clear capability requirements and priorities.

  • Establish scalable visual design principles, frameworks, standards, and recommended ways of working.

  • Help ensure that evolving design capabilities support brand consistency, accessibility, user experience, localization, and channel effectiveness.

  • Advise marketing and transformation leaders on emerging opportunities, capability gaps, and investment priorities related to visual design.

AI, Tools and Creative Technology

  • Identify and evaluate AI-enabled design tools, creative technologies, and emerging capabilities that could improve design quality, speed, scalability, or user experience.

  • Lead or support structured discovery, experimentation, and proof-of-concept work to assess potential business value.

  • Define practical use cases, success criteria, risks, and requirements for new tools and capabilities.

  • Partner with Digital, Technology, Procurement, Legal, Regulatory, and other relevant teams to support responsible evaluation and adoption.

  • Translate successful experimentation into repeatable workflows, guidance, and scalable solutions.

  • Monitor developments in generative AI, design automation, modular content, creative technology, and digital experience design.

Workflow and Operating-Model Transformation

  • Assess current visual design workflows and identify opportunities to simplify, automate, or improve them.

  • Help redesign how visual work is briefed, created, reviewed, adapted, localized, and reused.

  • Develop scalable approaches that allow global and local teams to work effectively across brands, markets, channels, and production partners.

  • Support the development of design systems, modular frameworks, templates, reusable components, and automation opportunities.

  • Partner with operations and transformation colleagues to embed new capabilities into broader content and marketing workflows.

  • Use feedback, adoption insights, and performance data to continuously improve tools and ways of working.

Designer Enablement and Coaching

  • Coach and mentor visual designers across internal teams, global pods, and partner organizations.

  • Help designers build confidence and proficiency in AI-enabled workflows, emerging creative tools, design systems, and modern digital practices.

  • Develop onboarding materials, playbooks, demonstrations, training programs, and practical learning resources.

  • Establish forums and communities of practice that encourage collaboration, knowledge sharing, experimentation, and continuous learning.

  • Provide constructive guidance and expert review when teams are adopting a new tool, workflow, or design approach.

  • Support the recruitment and onboarding of visual design talent where needed, helping ensure that skills and role profiles align with future capability requirements.

Standards, Governance and Quality Enablement

  • Establish clear guardrails for the responsible and effective use of AI within visual design.

  • Develop frameworks that help teams maintain appropriate standards for quality, brand integrity, accessibility, user experience, and regulatory compliance.

  • Create evaluation criteria that allow teams to assess the quality and suitability of AI-generated or AI-assisted visual outputs.

  • Partner with brand, regulatory, legal, and technology stakeholders to address risks and clarify appropriate uses of emerging capabilities.

  • Help teams balance creative experimentation with the standards required in a highly regulated environment.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner closely with Marketing, Content Strategy, Digital, Technology, Operations, brand teams, markets, agencies, and external vendors.

  • Act as the bridge between designers, marketers, technology teams, and business stakeholders when defining or implementing new capabilities.

  • Facilitate working sessions that turn business challenges into practical design and technology solutions.

  • Communicate complex design and technology concepts in a clear, actionable way for both creative and non-creative audiences.

  • Contribute to the broader Marketing Transformation & AI Strategy roadmap and help connect visual design priorities with other transformation initiatives.

About You

Qualifications

  • Degree or equivalent practical experience in graphic design, visual communications, digital design, experience design, creative technology, or a related discipline.

  • 10+ years of experience across visual design, digital experience, creative technology, design systems, creative operations, or related fields.

  • Deep visual design expertise and strong professional judgment, supported by a portfolio demonstrating work across digital channels, formats, and customer experiences.

  • Demonstrated experience building capabilities, developing standards, improving workflows, or leading design transformation—not solely producing individual assets.

  • Strong understanding of AI-enabled creative workflows, generative AI, design automation, modular content systems, and emerging creative technologies.

  • Experience evaluating tools and translating new technology into practical, scalable business applications.

  • Ability to coach, mentor, and develop designers with different levels of experience and technical maturity.

  • Experience creating playbooks, frameworks, training programs, design systems, or reusable approaches that improve the performance of other teams.

  • Strong understanding of digital experience, accessibility, responsive design, channel requirements, and customer-centered design principles.

  • Ability to work across global teams, markets, agencies, vendors, and distributed operating models.

  • Strong facilitation, stakeholder-management, and communication skills.

  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, move between strategy and practical implementation, and manage multiple priorities.

  • Experience in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, or another regulated industry is preferred but not required.

  • Fluency in English is required.

Why Choose Us?

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.

  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.

  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.

  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.

  • Help shape the future of care for chronic and complex conditions like aT1D, Type 2 diabetes, transplant, and cardiovascular disease

  • Drive meaningful impact at global scale: our medicines reach more than 100 million people each year.
